definition: Count of distinct ULC-active buyers on the snapshot day: buyers whose purchase-activity interval covers dt. Not same-day purchasers only and not DAU. One buyer active on five snapshot days contributes five when summed across days (buyer-days), not unique buyers over the window.
scope_filter: ulc_active_buyers user×day facts; purchase-activity interval covers snapshot day
aliases: active buyers, ULC buyers, lifecycle buyers, 活跃买家, 活跃买家数

definition: Row count at user_id × dt grain on the ULC active-buyer snapshot. Equals distinct active buyers when each buyer has one row per day; use when the measure is active-buyer-day rows rather than count_distinct of user_id. Summing across days yields buyer-days.
scope_filter: ulc_active_buyers user×day facts; row grain
aliases: buyer_day_rows, active buyer-days, 活跃买家天, 活跃买家日行数

definition: Count of distinct ULC-active buyers with lifecycle = New on dt (first interval, <28 days from start_dt).
scope_filter: ulc_active_buyers user×day facts; lifecycle = New
aliases: lifecycle new, new active buyers, 新买家, 生命周期新买家

definition: Count of distinct ULC-active buyers with lifecycle = Retained on dt.
scope_filter: ulc_active_buyers user×day facts; lifecycle = Retained
aliases: lifecycle retained, retained active buyers, 留存买家, 生命周期留存买家

definition: Count of distinct ULC-active buyers with lifecycle = Resurrected on dt.
scope_filter: ulc_active_buyers user×day facts; lifecycle = Resurrected
aliases: lifecycle resurrected, resurrected active buyers, 回流买家, 复活买家

definition: Count of distinct ULC-active buyers with loyal_flag = 1 (loyal_cycles >= 2) on dt.
scope_filter: ulc_active_buyers user×day facts; loyal_flag = 1
aliases: loyal buyers, loyal_flag, 忠诚买家, 忠诚活跃买家数

definition: Count of distinct ULC-active buyers with power_flag = 1 (power_days >= 4 in the rolling 28-day purchase-day window) on dt.
scope_filter: ulc_active_buyers user×day facts; power_flag = 1
aliases: power buyers, power_flag, 重度买家, 高活跃买家数

definition: Count of packed ULC activity interval rows at user_id × start_dt grain. Each DAU day seeds a 28-day candidate window; overlapping windows merge so an interval may span 28 or more calendar days. Row count of intervals — not count_distinct users, not DAU, not interval calendar length, and not session count.

aliases: intervals,packed intervals,activity intervals,ULC intervals,区间行数,活跃区间数

definition: Count of packed interval rows where previous_start_dt is NULL — the user's first packed interval in that merge history (New lifecycle).
scope_filter: ulc_base_users packed intervals; previous_start_dt IS NULL
aliases: new_intervals,first interval,首次区间,新活跃区间,New intervals

definition: Count of packed interval rows with a contiguous 1-day gap from the prior interval end (Retained lifecycle).
scope_filter: ulc_base_users packed intervals; 1-day gap from prior end
aliases: retained_intervals,retained intervals,留存区间,连续活跃区间,Retained intervals

definition: Count of packed interval rows where the user returned after a gap of more than 1 day since the prior interval end (Resurrected lifecycle).
scope_filter: ulc_base_users packed intervals; gap > 1 day from prior end
aliases: resurrected_intervals,resurrected intervals,回流区间,复活活跃区间,Resurrected intervals

definition: Count of add-to-cart log event rows at event grain (one logged ATC action = one event, not a cart line or units-added quantity). Includes bot and deleted-user traffic when present. Covers ATC detail and feed-tile rows with action=add_to_cart. Do not use count_distinct of users.
scope_filter: ATC event or feed-tile detail rows with action=add_to_cart; includes bots
aliases: add to cart events, ATC events, cart adds, a2c events, 加购次数, 加购事件数

definition: Count of add-to-cart log event rows excluding likely bots and deleted users. Standard quality-filtered ATC event volume for buyer-funnel denominators.
scope_filter: ATC event detail; likely_bot<>true; is_deleted_user<>true
aliases: non-bot ATC events, quality-filtered add to cart, 剔bot加购, 非机器人加购次数

definition: Count of add-to-cart log event rows where both page_type and module_type are non-null. Attribution-completeness cut of the same event count — not a country/channel/page slice.
scope_filter: ATC event detail; page_type IS NOT NULL; module_type IS NOT NULL
aliases: mapped ATC events, attributed add to cart, 已归因加购, 页面模块已映射加购

definition: Sum of pre-aggregated add-to-cart action counters at product-day or user-day grain. Same ATC volume as count when the counter is one-per-event, but recipe is SUM of a daily measure — never average it and never treat as distinct ATC users.
scope_filter: product-day or user-day ATC action counters (e.g. add_to_carts, num_of_a2c); upstream bot/guest filters vary by source
aliases: add_to_carts, num_of_a2c, a2c actions sum, 加购次数合计, 日加购次数

definition: Sum of the quantity attached to each add-to-cart log event (per-event add amount). Additive unit volume at ATC event grain — never average it, never treat as cart-line or paid-order units sold, and never count distinct ATC events or users.
scope_filter: ATC event detail rows
aliases: add_to_cart_quantity,ATC quantity,units added to cart,quantity added,加购件数,加购数量合计

definition: Average quantity added per add-to-cart event. A mean over ATC events — never sum; split from sum. Same recipe as quantity-per-event ratios of ATC quantity over event count.
scope_filter: ATC event detail rows
aliases: add_to_cart_quantity_per_event,ATC qty per event,avg ATC quantity,单次加购件数,加购均件

definition: Add-to-cart event intensity over impressions: sum(add_to_carts) / sum(impressions) as a 0–1 fraction at product-day grain. Same-scope ATC and impression counters from the commerce product-day fact — not ATC-users-per-click-users, not ATC-actions-per-clicks, not avg price/quantity per ATC event, and not CTR.
scope_filter: daily commerce product-day facts; upstream bot/China-IP/excluded-txn filters already applied; product-day inclusion gate
aliases: add_to_cart_rate,ATC rate,ATC over impressions,add to cart rate,加购率,曝光加购率

definition: Share of click users who also add-to-cart on the activity day: count_distinct(a2c user_id) / count_distinct(click user_id) as a 0–1 fraction. User-incidence funnel over the same click-user population — not ATC-events-per-impression and not summed ATC-actions-per-clicks.
scope_filter: user×day DAU facts (registered; guest/bot inclusion varies by source); denominator click users; numerator a2c users
aliases: a2c_rate,a2c user rate,ATC users over click users,click-to-a2c,点击用户加购率,加购转化率

definition: Add-to-cart action intensity over clicks: sum(a2c actions) / sum(clicks) as a 0–1 fraction on the activity day. Event-sum over event-sum — never mix with distinct a2c-user / click-user incidence, and not ATC over impressions.
scope_filter: user×day DAU facts; numerator total ATC action counters; denominator total clicks
aliases: event_a2c_rate,event a2c rate,ATC actions over clicks,a2c per click,点击加购事件率,事件加购率

definition: Average logged product price (USD) per add-to-cart event: mean of event price, or sum(ATC price) / count(ATC events) over the same ATC event detail scope. A per-event average intensity — never a sum of ATC price, and not ATC-over-impressions or click-funnel rates.
scope_filter: ATC event detail rows (add_to_cart_detail / add_to_cart_data_detail)
aliases: add_to_cart_price_per_event,add_to_cart_avg_price,ATC avg price,ATC price per event,加购均价,单次加购均价

definition: Average quantity added per add-to-cart event: mean of event quantity, or sum(ATC quantity) / count(ATC events) over the same ATC event detail scope. A per-event average intensity — never a sum of ATC quantity, and not ATC-over-impressions or click-funnel rates.
scope_filter: ATC event detail rows (add_to_cart_detail / add_to_cart_data_detail)
aliases: add_to_cart_quantity_per_event,ATC quantity per event,avg ATC quantity,单次加购件数,加购件均量

definition: Count of distinct logged-in user_id with at least one add-to-cart event in the window. Guest sessions with null user_id are excluded, so this is lower than the visitor-keyed recipe. One user counted once; summing daily distincts across days is not unique ATC users over the window. Not ATC event count and not buyers.

aliases: add_to_cart_users,ATC users,logged-in ATC users,registered ATC users,加购用户,加购注册用户

definition: Count of distinct visitor_id behind add-to-cart events (guest and logged-in traffic keyed on visitor identity; guest-only extracts from the unknown payload are the same visitor-scope recipe). Broader than registered ATC users when both keys exist. Not ATC event count and not buyers.
scope_filter: ATC event detail; distinct visitor_id (guest and/or logged-in)
aliases: add_to_cart_visitors,ATC visitors,cart visitors,加购访客,加购访客数

definition: Sum of logged product price (USD) across add-to-cart events. Core at-cart listed amount — intent/cart value only, not realized GMV, revenue, or paid order value. Additive over ATC event rows; split from average.
scope_filter: ATC event detail rows
aliases: add_to_cart_price,ATC price,cart listed price,加购标价,加购金额,at-cart price

definition: Sum of merchant-side product price (USD) logged at add-to-cart time. Merchant-price component of ATC value — related to but not interchangeable with buyer-facing product price.
scope_filter: ATC event detail rows
aliases: add_to_cart_merchant_price,ATC merchant price,加购商家价,商家加购价

definition: Sum of event-level shipping amount (USD) logged at add-to-cart time. At-cart shipping component — not buyer-paid order shipping and not merchant shipping_cost COGS.
scope_filter: ATC event detail rows
aliases: add_to_cart_shipping,ATC shipping,加购运费,加购运费金额

definition: Sum of merchant-side shipping amount (USD) logged at add-to-cart time. Merchant shipping component of ATC value — not event-level add_to_cart_shipping and not paid order shipping.
scope_filter: ATC event detail rows
aliases: add_to_cart_merchant_shipping,ATC merchant shipping,加购商家运费

definition: Sum of product cost (USD) logged at add-to-cart time. At-cart cost component — intent grain only, not sold-item or refund COGS.
scope_filter: ATC event detail rows
aliases: add_to_cart_cost,ATC cost,加购成本,加购商品成本

definition: Sum of shipping cost (USD) logged at add-to-cart time. At-cart shipping-cost component — not buyer-facing shipping amount and not post-purchase logistics COGS.
scope_filter: ATC event detail rows
aliases: add_to_cart_shipping_cost,ATC shipping cost,加购运费成本

definition: Average item value: sum(gmv) / sum(quantity) — or sum(purchases) when the source names purchased units that way — over the same commerce scope and period, excluding limited-time-deal lines under the house LTD convention when the source defines it. Denominator is purchased units, not distinct orders or buyers. A rate of summed GMV over summed units — never a sum of per-row AIV, and not ATV/AOV or GMV per buyer.
scope_filter: payment-received variation lines or daily commerce product-day facts; excl LTD when present on the source; excl Wish Cash and BNPL special variations; excl pending/declined/exception; excl refunds before payment received; product-day facts inherit upstream bot/China-IP/excluded-txn filters and the product-day inclusion gate
aliases: aiv, average item value, GMV per unit, GMV per purchase unit, gmv_per_purchase, 件单价, 单件均价, average unit price

definition: Average transaction value per distinct commerce checkout: sum(gmv) / count_distinct(transaction_id) on payment-received variation lines, or GMV / pre-aggregated txn counts on buyer-day facts, excluding limited-time-deal items. Numerator and denominator must share scope, period, and LTD convention. A rate of summed GMV over distinct transactions — never a sum of per-row ATV, and not a line-count, merchant-order, or parcel denominator.
scope_filter: payment-received variation lines or buyer-day facts; excl LTD; excl Wish Cash and BNPL special variations; excl pending/declined/exception; excl refunds before payment received
aliases: atv, aov, average order value, average transaction value, 客单价, 单均价, average basket value, 每单金额, gmv per distinct transaction, GMV per transaction

definition: Average GMV per variation line: sum(gmv) / count(*) of payment-received variation lines, excluding limited-time-deal items. Denominator is line count (count), not count_distinct transactions — WBR topline gmv_per_order convention. Same-scope/period/LTD rate; never sum per-row ratios.
scope_filter: payment-received variation lines; excl LTD; excl Wish Cash and BNPL special variations; excl pending/declined/exception; excl refunds before payment received
aliases: gmv_per_order, gmv per line, gmv per order line, gmv per variation line, WBR aov, 行均GMV, 单行客单价

definition: Average GMV per merchant transaction: sum(gmv) / count of merchant orders at m_transaction_id grain on the merchant-transaction fact. Denominator is merchant-order count, not distinct commerce checkouts, variation lines, or parcels. A rate — never a sum of per-order ATV.
scope_filter: merchant transaction facts; one row per m_transaction_id
aliases: avg_order_value, merchant aov, merchant average order value, 商家客单价, 商家单均GMV, GMV per merchant order

definition: Average GMV per distinct WishPost parcel: sum(gmv) / count_distinct(tracking_id) on WishPost full-cycle parcel facts. NULL when there are no parcels in scope. Denominator is distinct parcels, not commerce transactions, variation lines, or merchant orders. Snapshot dt re-lists parcels across partitions — use a single snapshot dt or order_created_day for business-date cuts. A rate — never a sum of per-parcel ratios.
scope_filter: wishpost_order_clean_full_cycle; first-mile tracking_id grain; single snapshot dt when cutting on dt
aliases: gmv_per_parcel, GMV per parcel, 包裹均GMV, 单包裹GMV, GMV per tracking_id

definition: Share of attributed daily active users who purchase on the attribution day: buyers / DAU as a 0–1 fraction. Numerator and denominator share the same user×day attribution population and same-day purchase flags; purchase/txn sides exclude LTD upstream. User-incidence conversion over DAU — not ATC rate, not CTR, and not the incoming-order approval funnel.
scope_filter: dau_attribution user×day; same-day buyers over attributed DAU; purchase metrics excl LTD upstream
aliases: buyer rate, conversion rate, CVR, buyers over DAU, 购买转化率, 转化率

definition: Share of distinct users with an incoming order on the transaction day whose order was approved or payment-received: approved_orders / incoming_orders, both count_distinct user_id. Numerator keeps users with coalesce(payment_received_time, order_approved_time) not null. Funnel rate over the same incoming-order user population — not buyers/DAU conversion and not a GMV share.
scope_filter: commerce transaction facts; incoming-order users; approved or payment-received numerator; excl placeholder variations used by WBR buyers_raw
aliases: approval rate, order approval rate, incoming order user approval rate, 订单通过率, 下单批准比例, 当日进单批准率

definition: Count of distinct buyer user_id with at least one purchase (or in-scope commerce activity) in the window. Guest checkouts with null user_id are typically excluded. One buyer counted once; summing daily distincts across days is not unique buyers over the window. Not DAU, not active_buyers lifecycle membership, not transaction count, and not buyer-day row count.
scope_filter: commerce / buyer / parcel facts with a purchasing user_id; guest nulls excluded when present
aliases: buyers,purchasers,下单用户,购买人数,distinct buyers,buyer count,购买用户数

definition: Row count at user_id × payment-day grain when the source is already one row per buyer per day. Uses COUNT of rows, not COUNT DISTINCT. Summing across days yields user-days, not unique buyers over the window.
scope_filter: daily buyer user×day facts; non-LTD purchase activity; row grain
aliases: buyer_day_rows,buyer-days,user-days,购买用户天,买家天行数

definition: Count of distinct user_id with a payment-received purchase, excluding LTD products. House EXP / daily-buyer recipe — not interchangeable with the LTD-inclusive count.
scope_filter: payment-received variation or buyer-day facts; exclude LTD; excl Wish Cash/BNPL special variations and pending/declined/exception when applicable
aliases: buyers excl LTD,buyer,去LTD购买用户,剔LTD买家数

definition: Count of distinct user_id with a payment-received purchase, including LTD products. EXP name buyer_w_ltd — same commerce scope as excl_ltd with LTD kept.
scope_filter: payment-received variation facts; include LTD; excl Wish Cash/BNPL special variations and pending/declined/exception when applicable
aliases: buyers_w_ltd,buyer_w_ltd,含LTD购买用户,含LTD买家数

definition: Count of distinct users with same-day attributed purchases on the attribution day (flag_buyer = YES). Purchase/GMV side excludes LTD upstream. Last-touch MDE channel attribution — not unattributed purchase buyers.
scope_filter: dau_attribution user×day; flag_buyer=YES; purchase metrics excl LTD upstream
aliases: same-day buyers,attributed buyers,flag_buyer,当日购买用户,归因买家数

definition: Count of distinct users with an approved or payment-received order: coalesce(payment_received_time, order_approved_time) IS NOT NULL. WBR-style filter excludes the two placeholder variations. Narrower than incoming-order users.
scope_filter: commerce transaction facts; approved or payment-received; excl placeholder variations
aliases: approved_orders,approved buyers,payment-received users,批准订单用户,已支付用户数

definition: Count of distinct users with an incoming order (WBR buyers_raw). Glossary uses user_id with the two placeholder variations excluded. Broader than approved / payment-received users.
scope_filter: commerce transaction facts; incoming orders; excl placeholder variations
aliases: incoming_orders,buyers_raw,进单用户,下单用户数

definition: Count of distinct buyer user_id with at least one refund event. Refund-scope recipe of the buyers root — not purchase buyers and not refund transaction count.
scope_filter: refund facts; at least one refund event
aliases: refunded_buyers,refunded purchasers,退款用户,退款买家数

definition: Count of distinct buyers that submitted at least one logged product-rating event. Rating-submitter incidence — not review/document count and not purchase buyers.
scope_filter: product rating event log
aliases: distinct_rating_users,rating submitters,评价用户,评分用户数

definition: Count of distinct buyer user_id among order-tracking records. A buyer with many tracking rows is counted once — not a shipment or tracking-record count.
scope_filter: order tracking facts
aliases: distinct_users,tracked buyers,有物流买家,运单买家数

definition: Sum of per-parcel Wish buyer-id counts (cnt_wish_user_id) over WishPost parcels in scope — a SUM of identifiers on parcels, not count_distinct buyers. Restrict to a single snapshot dt when the fact is rolling-window.
scope_filter: WishPost full-cycle parcel facts
aliases: cnt_wish_user_id,summed buyer ids on parcels,包裹买家数合计

definition: Sum of pre-aggregated same-day click-event counters at user×day grain. Additive across users and days — five clicks contribute five. Upstream bot/guest/temporary-user filters vary by source (registered-only DAU vs DAU-with-guests). Never average; not an event-row count, not distinct clickers, not CTR, and not add-to-cart.
scope_filter: user-day click counters (e.g. num_of_clicks); upstream bot/guest filters vary by source
aliases: num_of_clicks, click events sum, in-app clicks, same-day clicks, 点击次数合计, 日点击次数, tile clicks sum

definition: Count of feed-tile interaction detail rows with `action` = 'clicked'. Tile grain: one logged click of a multi-product feed counts once per product. Includes bot traffic. Event-row count — not a sum of daily counters, not distinct clickers, and not CTR.
scope_filter: feed-tile interaction detail; action=clicked; includes bots
aliases: feed tile clicks, tile clicks, product clicks, feed_tile_clicks, 点击事件数, 磁贴点击

definition: Count of distinct merchandising collection_id in the selected feed, merchandising, or engagement scope. One collection is counted once; null collection_id is excluded. Not product or variation count and not add-to-cart event count.
scope_filter: any collections-root model; collection_id IS NOT NULL
aliases: collections,distinct collections,collection count,merchandising collections,选品集,选品集数,集合数

definition: Count of distinct merchandising collection_id among add-to-cart events that carry collection metadata. A collection appearing on many ATC events is counted once — not ATC event count and not distinct ATC products.
scope_filter: add-to-cart event detail; collection_id IS NOT NULL
aliases: add_to_cart_collections,ATC collections,carted collections,加购选品集,加购集合数,加购选品集数

definition: Sum of merchant item COGS at commerce-line, merchant-transaction, or refund-line grain (cost / merchant_cost / localized_merchant_cost). Item cost only — before merchant shipping and before the responsibility split. Additive; multi-currency unless the source is already localized/USD. Not buyer refund amount, not processor fees, and not WishPost carrier purchase cost.
scope_filter: commerce/merchant sold or refunded lines; exclude is_testing when present
aliases: COGS,merchant cost,item cost,成本,给商家的成本,merchant_cost,localized_merchant_cost,商品成本合计

definition: Sum of merchant-attributed shipping cost at line, merchant-transaction, or refund-line grain (merchant_shipping / merchant_shipping_cost / localized_merchant_shipping[_cost]). Merchant cost-basis shipping — not buyer-paid shipping, not WishPost carrier purchase fees, and not item COGS.
scope_filter: commerce/merchant sold or refunded lines; exclude is_testing when present

definition: Sum of combined merchant cost basis on refund lines: (item cost + merchant shipping cost) × quantity, adjusted by partial_amount_percentage for PARTIAL_AMOUNT refunds (merchant_amount). Merchant cost owed/attributed — not the amount refunded to the buyer and not the responsibility-share eat-cost alone.
scope_filter: commerce or merchant refund lines; exclude is_testing when present
aliases: merchant_amount,merchant cost basis,商家成本基数,退款商家成本基数,(cost+shipping)*qty

definition: Same combined merchant cost basis as sum_basis, plus the WishPost shipping refund that applies to Unity orders (merchant_amount_with_wishpost), in the merchant source currency. Not interchangeable with the plain sum_basis recipe.
scope_filter: merchant refund lines; Unity WishPost shipping refund when applicable
aliases: merchant_amount_with_wishpost,merchant basis with WishPost,含WishPost成本基数,Unity商家成本基数

definition: Sum of the merchant responsibility-share eat-cost: merchant_amount × merchant_responsibility (or merchant_eat_cost_amount). Finance/risk OKR eat-cost — not the full merchant cost basis and not the buyer refund amount.
scope_filter: commerce/merchant refund lines or merchant transactions with eat-cost; exclude is_testing when present
aliases: merchant_responsible_amount,merchant eat cost,商家承担成本,商家吃成本,eat-cost,merchant_eat_cost_amount

definition: Same responsibility-share eat-cost as sum_responsible, plus the WishPost shipping refund that applies to Unity orders (merchant_responsible_amount_with_wishpost). Not interchangeable with the plain sum_responsible recipe.
scope_filter: merchant refund lines; Unity WishPost shipping refund when applicable
aliases: merchant_responsible_amount_with_wishpost,eat-cost with WishPost,含WishPost承担成本,Unity商家承担成本

definition: Sum of the merchant-set item price (merchant_price / localized_merchant_price) at commerce-line or merchant-transaction grain. Merchant price basis / proceeds from the product — not item COGS when cost differs, not shipping, and not buyer-paid price.
scope_filter: commerce or merchant transaction lines; exclude is_testing when present
aliases: merchant_price,merchant price basis,商家标价,商户价格,localized_merchant_price

definition: Sum of merchant payment / payout amounts (merchant_payment_amount) at merchant-transaction grain. Payout owed to or settled with the merchant — not item COGS, not eat-cost, and not buyer refund amount.
scope_filter: merchant transactions; exclude is_testing when present
aliases: merchant_payment_amount,merchant payout,商家付款,商家结算金额,merchant payment

definition: Sum of merchant value as (merchant_price + merchant_shipping) × quantity over parcels in scope (total_merchant_value). Additive merchant COGS/value rollup on WishPost parcel grain — restrict to a single dt when the source is a rolling snapshot. Not buyer GMV and not carrier purchase cost.
scope_filter: WishPost full-cycle parcels; single dt when snapshot
aliases: total_merchant_value,merchant value,商家货值,(merchant_price+merchant_shipping)*qty,商户货值合计

definition: Average merchant value per order/parcel (avg_merchant_value), typically merchant_price + merchant_shipping as reduced by the upstream join. A mean — never sum; split from sum_value and from max_value.
scope_filter: WishPost full-cycle parcels; single dt when snapshot
aliases: avg_merchant_value,average merchant value,商家货值均值,单均商家货值

definition: Maximum merchant value per order/parcel (max_merchant_value) when the sweep already reduced value to one row per tracking_id. An extreme — not an average and not an additive period total.
scope_filter: WishPost full-cycle parcels; single dt when snapshot
aliases: max_merchant_value,maximum merchant value,商家货值最大,最大商家货值

definition: Average catalog-snapshot cost to Wish per variation in scope (avg_cost). A mean over variations in a single snapshot partition — never sum; multi-currency mixed average. Not additive COGS on sold lines and not consignment supply cost.
scope_filter: product-variation catalog snapshot; single dt partition
aliases: avg_cost,average cost,catalog average cost,目录均成本,平均成本,variation avg cost

definition: Sum of consignment supply cost over variations in a single catalog snapshot partition (total_consignment_supply_cost). Point-in-time catalog amount — not additive across snapshot dates; multi-currency. Not ordinary sold-line COGS.
scope_filter: product-variation catalog snapshot; single dt partition
aliases: consignment supply cost,total_consignment_supply_cost,寄售供货成本,寄售成本

definition: Click-through rate at product-tile grain: sum(clicks) / sum(impressions) as a 0–1 fraction. Same-scope click and impression counters from feed-tile interaction detail (action grain). Includes bot traffic unless filtered. Event-sum over event-sum — not click-users-over-DAU and not total-clicks-per-DAU.
scope_filter: feed-tile interaction detail; tile-grain clicks over impressions; bots included unless likely_bot filtered
aliases: CTR, click through rate, tile CTR, feed tile CTR, 点击率, 曝光点击率

definition: Share of daily active users who click on the activity day: count_distinct(click user_id) / DAU as a 0–1 fraction. User-incidence Datapack & WBR recipe over the same user×day population — not clicks-over-impressions and not total-clicks-per-DAU.
scope_filter: user×day DAU facts (registered; guest/bot inclusion varies by source); numerator click users; denominator DAU
aliases: click_rate, click rate, click users over DAU, Datapack CTR, WBR click rate, 点击用户占比, 点击率

definition: Click intensity per daily active user: sum(clicks) / DAU as events-per-user (not bounded to 0–1). Total click counters over the same user×day DAU population — not click-user incidence and not tile clicks-over-impressions.
scope_filter: user×day DAU facts (registered; guest/bot inclusion varies by source); numerator total clicks; denominator DAU
aliases: click_per_dau, clicks per DAU, click intensity, 人均点击, 人均点击次数

definition: Count of distinct active user_id at user×day grain on the activity or ULC snapshot day (registered DAU from fct_dau-style facts, ULC-active when the activity interval covers the snapshot day, or interacting users on feed-tile detail). One user active on five days contributes five when summed across days (user-days), not unique users over the window. Not buyers and not active_buyers.
scope_filter: user×day activity, ULC-active/power-day, or feed-tile interacting-user facts; registered / bots-temp filtered upstream when from fct_dau; or activity interval covers snapshot day
aliases: DAU,daily active users,日活,active users,ULC active users,lifecycle users,feed tile users,日活跃用户数

definition: Row count at user_id × dt grain when the source is already one row per active user per day. Uses COUNT of rows, not COUNT DISTINCT. Equals distinct DAU when each user has one row per day; summing across days yields user-days.
scope_filter: user×day DAU / ULC-active / power-day facts; row grain
aliases: user_day_rows,fct_dau_rows,active user-days,活跃用户天,日活行数

definition: Count of distinct users at user×day grain on the marketing attribution day, with MDE last-touch touch_event attached. Same quantity as DAU but measured on the attributed user-day fact — not unattributed fct_dau activity DAU.
scope_filter: dau_attribution user×day; MDE last-touch touch_event present
aliases: attributed DAU,marketing attributed DAU,MDE DAU,归因日活,归因日活用户

definition: User-day volume where the Install_Ads touch flag is set (sum of flag_install_ads_30d / touch_event = Install_Ads). Additive user-days — not count_distinct users over the window.
scope_filter: dau_attribution user×day; flag_install_ads_30d=1 or touch_event=Install_Ads
aliases: install_ads_user_days,Install Ads user-days,Install_Ads日活天,安装广告用户天

definition: Count of distinct daily active users including registered and guest traffic (and bots when enabled upstream). Broader than registered-only fct_dau DAU.
scope_filter: fct_dau_w_bots-style user×day facts; registered + guest (+ bots if enabled)
aliases: dau w guests,registered and guest DAU,含访客日活,含Guest日活

definition: Count of distinct guest / logged-out DAU (user_type = Guest).
scope_filter: user×day facts including guests; user_type = Guest
aliases: guest_dau,guest users,访客日活,未登录日活

definition: Count of distinct registered-account DAU (user_type = Registered) on sources that also carry guests.
scope_filter: user×day facts including guests; user_type = Registered
aliases: registered_dau,registered DAU,注册用户日活,已登录账号日活

definition: Count of distinct users who signed in during the activity day.
scope_filter: user×day facts; signed in on activity day
aliases: signed_in_dau,signed-in DAU,当日登录用户,签到登录日活

definition: Count of distinct users with meaningful same-day engagement: num_clicks + num_a2c_actions > 0 (good_dau). Stricter than raw DAU; not event counts.
scope_filter: user×day facts; num_clicks + num_a2c_actions > 0
aliases: good_dau,engaged users,有效日活,有点击或加购的日活

definition: Count of distinct users with at least one instance of a given same-day engagement behaviour (product/server impression, click, add-to-cart, wishlist, cart-page visit, or cart visit plus A2C). One user with many events of that kind still counts once — not the event count.
scope_filter: user×day engagement facts; at least one of the chosen behaviour on dt
aliases: imp_user,click_user,a2c_user,wishlist_user,cart_visits_user,cart_visits_and_a2c_user,行为用户,互动行为日活

definition: Count of distinct ULC-active users with lifecycle = New on dt (first interval, <28 days from start_dt).
scope_filter: ulc_active_users user×day facts; lifecycle = New
aliases: lifecycle new,new active users,新用户,生命周期新日活

definition: Count of distinct ULC-active users with lifecycle = Retained on dt.
scope_filter: ulc_active_users user×day facts; lifecycle = Retained
aliases: lifecycle retained,retained active users,留存用户,生命周期留存日活

definition: Count of distinct ULC-active users with lifecycle = Resurrected on dt.
scope_filter: ulc_active_users user×day facts; lifecycle = Resurrected
aliases: lifecycle resurrected,resurrected active users,回流用户,复活日活

definition: Count of distinct ULC-active users with loyal_flag = 1 (loyal_cycles >= 2) on dt.
scope_filter: ulc_active_users user×day facts; loyal_flag = 1
aliases: loyal users,loyal_flag,忠诚用户,忠诚日活

definition: Count of distinct active users with power_flag = 1 (power_days >= 10 in the rolling 28-day DAU window) on dt.
scope_filter: ulc_active_users or ulc_power_user user×day facts; power_flag = 1 or power_days >= 10
aliases: power users,power_flag,重度用户,高活跃日活

definition: Count of distinct users with a packed ULC activity interval ending on the selected partition day (interval end date). Summing across partitions yields interval-ending user-days, not unique users over the window.
scope_filter: ulc_base_users packed intervals; partition dt = end_dt
aliases: interval users,interval-ending users,区间用户,区间结束日活

definition: Sum of customs or insurance declared merchandise value over WishPost first-mile parcels (tracking_id) in scope. Additive at parcel grain — never average into a period total. Restrict to a single snapshot dt: the rolling ~200-day window re-emits each parcel across consecutive partitions, so multi-dt sums over-count. Not marketplace GMV, not merchandise revenue or merchant value, and not parcel weight.
scope_filter: WishPost full-cycle parcel snapshot; single dt; customs/insurance declared value
aliases: declared value,customs declared value,insurance declared value,申报价值,申报货值,海关申报价值

definition: Average customs or insurance declared merchandise value per WishPost first-mile parcel (tracking_id). A mean over parcels — never sum this recipe as a period total. Split from the additive sum. Restrict to a single snapshot dt when cutting on dt. Not GMV, revenue, or parcel weight.
scope_filter: WishPost full-cycle parcel snapshot; single dt; customs/insurance declared value
aliases: avg declared value,average declared value,mean declared value,包裹均申报价值,单包裹申报价值

definition: Share of confirmed shipments that were delivered: confirmed_delivered_shipments / confirmed_shipments as a 0–1 fraction. Unconfirmed tracking records are excluded from both sides. Delivered shipments are always a subset of confirmed shipments. A rate — never summed across periods.
scope_filter: confirmed shipments only; numerator is_delivered=true
aliases: confirmed shipment delivery rate, delivery rate over confirmed shipments, delivered share, 确认运单妥投率, 确认运单签收率, 确认运单送达率

definition: Share of confirmed shipments that failed delivery: confirmed_failed_deliveries / confirmed_shipments as a 0–1 fraction. Unconfirmed tracking records are excluded from both sides. Allowed complementary failure recipe of delivery_rate — not its arithmetic complement, because a failed parcel can later deliver or be resent.
scope_filter: confirmed shipments only; numerator is_delivery_failure=true
aliases: confirmed shipment failure rate, delivery failure rate, failure rate over confirmed shipments, 确认运单配送失败率, 妥投失败率

definition: Share of WishPost first-mile parcels in a single snapshot partition that reached the delivered last-mile checkpoint (delivered_ts not null): delivered_parcels / parcels as a 0–1 fraction. Restrict to one dt before reading the rate; not the confirmed-shipment OTI recipe and not time-to-delivery.
scope_filter: WishPost full-cycle parcel snapshot; single dt; numerator delivered_ts not null
aliases: parcel delivery rate, wishpost delivery rate, delivered parcel share, 包裹妥投率, 物流妥投率

definition: Sum of the promotional or coupon discount granted on a commerce transaction (discount_amount). On line-grain sources the value is repeated on every line of the same transaction, so collapse to one row per transaction_id before summing. Multi-currency; not exchange-rate adjusted. Not GMV and not a proportional GMV deduction.
scope_filter: commerce transaction facts; exclude is_testing
aliases: discount amount,promo discount,coupon amount,折扣,优惠金额,促销折扣

definition: Sum of promotional discount swept onto WishPost first-mile parcels (tracking_id) within a single snapshot partition. Restrict to one dt — the rolling window re-emits each parcel across ~200 consecutive partitions, so multi-dt sums over-count. Not interchangeable with the transaction-collapse commerce recipe.
scope_filter: WishPost full-cycle parcel snapshot; single dt
aliases: parcel discount,wishpost discount,包裹折扣金额,物流折扣金额

definition: Share of ULC-active users flagged loyal on the snapshot day: loyal users / active users as a 0–1 fraction (loyal_flag = 1, loyal_cycles >= 2). Same-scope user×day population — not power-user share, not loyal-buyer share, and not raw loyal-user count.
scope_filter: ulc_active_users user×day; numerator loyal_flag = 1; denominator ULC-active users
aliases: loyal rate, loyalty rate, loyal user share, 忠诚用户占比, 高粘性用户占比

definition: Share of ULC-active buyers flagged loyal on the snapshot day: loyal buyers / active buyers as a 0–1 fraction (loyal_flag = 1, loyal_cycles >= 2). Same-scope buyer×day population — not loyal-user share, not power-buyer share, and not raw loyal-buyer count.
scope_filter: ulc_active_buyers user×day; numerator loyal_flag = 1; denominator ULC-active buyers
aliases: loyal buyer rate, loyal buyers over active buyers, 忠诚买家占比, 忠诚买家率

definition: Share of active or snapshot-day users flagged power on dt: power users / active (or snapshot) users as a 0–1 fraction (power_flag = 1 or power_days >= 10 over the rolling 28-day DAU window). Same-scope user×day population — not power-buyer share, not loyal-user share, and not raw power-user count.
scope_filter: ulc_active_users or ulc_power_user user×day; numerator power_flag = 1 or power_days >= 10; denominator active/snapshot users with DAU on dt
aliases: power user rate, power user share, 重度用户占比, 高活跃用户占比, power share

definition: Share of ULC-active buyers flagged power on the snapshot day: power buyers / active buyers as a 0–1 fraction (power_flag = 1, power_days >= 4 over the rolling 28-day purchase-day window). Same-scope buyer×day population — not power-user share, not loyal-buyer share, and not raw power-buyer count.
scope_filter: ulc_active_buyers user×day; numerator power_flag = 1 or power_days >= 4; denominator ULC-active buyers
aliases: power buyer rate, power buyers over active buyers, 重度买家占比, 高活跃买家占比

definition: Share of daily active users with meaningful same-day engagement (good DAU): good_dau / DAU as a 0–1 fraction, typically users with click or add-to-cart on the activity day. User-incidence rate over the same DAU population — not loyal/power threshold shares, not click-event intensity, and not raw good-DAU count.
scope_filter: fct_dau_w_bots-style user×day DAU; numerator good/engaged DAU (e.g. click or a2c); denominator total DAU
aliases: good DAU rate, good_dau_rate, engaged DAU rate, 优质DAU占比, 有效互动日活占比

definition: Share of ERP partner API activity combinations that returned a non-200 HTTP status: non-200 combinations / all activity combinations as a 0–1 fraction. Grain is the deduplicated (dt, merchant_id, partner_id, tid, response_status, uri, code) tuple — repeated identical calls in a day collapse, so this is not raw request failure volume. All endpoint URIs in partner OAuth activity. A rate — never summed across periods. Not ERP event count and not refund rate.
scope_filter: erp_daily_dump deduped activity combinations; partner_id not null; numerator response_status != 200; all endpoints
aliases: ERP error rate,API error share,ERP失败率,non-200 share,ERP API error rate

definition: Share of order-fulfillment endpoint activity combinations that returned a non-200 HTTP status: non-200 fulfill-one combinations / all fulfill-one combinations as a 0–1 fraction. Same deduplicated combination grain; URI contains 'fulfill-one' (ChannelAdvisor-style fulfillment error signal). A rate — never summed across periods. Not all-endpoint ERP error rate and not fulfillment event count.
scope_filter: erp_daily_dump deduped activity combinations; partner_id not null; uri contains fulfill-one; numerator response_status != 200
aliases: fulfillment error rate,ERP fulfillment error rate,履约接口失败率,fulfill-one error share

definition: Count of deduplicated merchant ERP partner API activity combinations at (day, merchant, partner, event, HTTP status, URI, code) grain. Repeated identical calls inside a day collapse to one row — not raw request volume, not distinct partners, and not an error rate.
scope_filter: erp_daily_dump combination grain; partner_id not null
aliases: erp api events,erp calls,erp activity,API activity combinations,ERP接口事件,ERP活动组合数

definition: Count of deduplicated ERP API activity combinations whose HTTP response_status is 200.
scope_filter: erp_daily_dump combination grain; response_status = 200
aliases: erp api success events,HTTP 200 events,成功事件,ERP成功组合

definition: Count of deduplicated ERP API activity combinations whose HTTP response_status is not 200. Combination count of failures — not failed call volume and not the error rate.
scope_filter: erp_daily_dump combination grain; response_status ≠ 200
aliases: erp api error events,non-200 events,错误事件,ERP失败组合

definition: Count of deduplicated ERP API activity combinations against the order fulfillment endpoint family (URI contains 'fulfill-one').
scope_filter: erp_daily_dump combination grain; uri contains fulfill-one
aliases: erp fulfillment api events,fulfill-one events,履约接口事件,履约端点组合

definition: Count of deduplicated ERP API activity combinations against the fulfillment endpoint family (URI contains 'fulfill-one') that returned a non-200 HTTP status. ChannelAdvisor-style fulfillment error signal — not the error rate.
scope_filter: erp_daily_dump combination grain; uri contains fulfill-one; response_status ≠ 200
aliases: erp fulfillment error events,fulfill-one errors,履约错误事件,履约失败组合

definition: Count of distinct ERP/partner owner identities (partner_user_id or partner_id) in the selected scope — active OAuth authorization snapshot or ERP API activity day depending on the model. Prefer stable partner_user_id / partner_id over display-name spelling variants. One partner counted once; not merchant–partner grant-row count and not ERP API event volume.
scope_filter: any erp_partners-root model; distinct partner_user_id or partner_id
aliases: erp partners,partner apps,partner identities,distinct partners,ERP合作方,合作方数

definition: Count of distinct ERP partner OAuth applications (partner_id) with at least one activity on the day in erp_daily_dump. Activity-day incidence — not authorization inventory and not API event / combination volume.
scope_filter: erp_daily_dump; partner_id not null
aliases: active erp partners,partners with API activity,活跃ERP合作方,当日有调用合作方

definition: Count of distinct partner_user_id identities with at least one active (non-revoked) public Merchant App OAuth authorization in the selected period. Authorization-inventory recipe — not activity-day partners and not merchant×partner grant-row count.
scope_filter: merchant authorization snapshot; non-revoked public-app grant
aliases: authorized partners,OAuth partners,已授权合作方,授权中的ERP

definition: Count of distinct partner_name display labels in the authorization snapshot. Spelling variants of the same ERP can appear as separate values — weaker than partner_user_id distinct; prefer distinct or authorized for stable partner counts.
scope_filter: merchant authorization snapshot; distinct partner_name
aliases: partner names,partner display names,合作方名称数,partner_name去重

definition: Average of published USD→currency conversion rates (units of foreign currency per 1 USD). Default FX recipe from conversion-table snapshots; at currency-table grain equals the published rate — average carefully when multiple tables share one dt. A rate: average only, never sum; not GMV/revenue amounts and not the inverse currency→USD multiplier.
scope_filter: FX conversion-rate dimension or equivalent published rate rows; USD→currency direction
aliases: avg conversion rate,USD to FX,conversion_rate,USD兑外币,汇率均值,外汇中间价

definition: Average of treasury-style currency→USD multipliers, typically 1 / conversion_rate. Inverse of the USD→currency published rate — same FX population, opposite quote direction. Average only, never sum; not merchant settlement FX and not monetary amounts.
scope_filter: FX conversion-rate dimension; currency→USD / ex_rate direction
aliases: avg ex rate,ex_rate,FX to USD,currency to USD,外币兑美元,倒算汇率

definition: Average merchant-currency exchange rate recorded on merchant transactions. Settlement FX at m_transaction grain — average across transactions in scope, never sum; not the published USD→currency dim rate and not the hedged or daily-settlement variants.
scope_filter: merchant transaction facts; one rate per m_transaction when present
aliases: merchant exchange rate,merchant FX,商家汇率,商户结算汇率

definition: Average daily merchant-currency settlement exchange rate on merchant transactions. Day-marked settlement FX recipe — average only, never sum; distinct from the unhedged merchant rate and from the hedged merchant rate.
scope_filter: merchant transaction facts; daily settlement rate field
aliases: daily merchant FX,merchant daily exchange rate,商家日汇率,日结算汇率

definition: Average hedged merchant-currency exchange rate on merchant transactions. Hedge-adjusted settlement FX — average only, never sum; not the unhedged merchant rate, not the daily settlement rate, and not published dim conversion_rate.
scope_filter: merchant transaction facts; hedged settlement rate field
aliases: hedged exchange rate,hedged merchant FX,对冲汇率,套保汇率,商家对冲汇率

definition: Count of distinct subject_id with at least one experiment metric row in the selected experiment window. One subject counted once per scope even if present on many partition days, buckets, or metric_sources unless those are filtered; summing daily distincts across days is not unique subjects over the window. Not general DAU, registered users, or merchants outside experiment assignment.
scope_filter: fct_experiments_metrics (or equivalent); distinct subject_id; filter dt+metric_source+subject for partitions
aliases: experiment subjects,assigned subjects,test subjects,实验对象,实验对象数,subject count

definition: Row count at subject×experiment×bucket×day×metric_source grain. Uses COUNT of rows, not COUNT DISTINCT of subject_id. Equals distinct subjects only when each subject has one row in scope; summing across days yields subject-days / assignment-days.
scope_filter: experiment subject metric facts; row grain; filter dt+metric_source+subject for partitions
aliases: subject_day_rows,assignment rows,实验对象天,实验对象行数,subject-days

definition: Count of distinct subject_id where subject type is USER_ID (user-randomized experiments). Not merchant, visitor, or store subjects, and not general DAU.
scope_filter: experiment subject metrics; subject=USER_ID; distinct subject_id
aliases: user subjects,USER_ID subjects,用户实验对象,实验用户数

definition: Count of distinct subject_id where subject type is MERCHANT_ID (merchant-randomized experiments). Not the merchants root outside experiment assignment.
scope_filter: experiment subject metrics; subject=MERCHANT_ID; distinct subject_id
aliases: merchant subjects,MERCHANT_ID subjects,商家实验对象,实验商家数

definition: Count of distinct subject_id where subject type is VISITOR_ID (visitor-randomized experiments). Not registered-user experiment subjects and not general guest DAU.
scope_filter: experiment subject metrics; subject=VISITOR_ID; distinct subject_id
aliases: visitor subjects,VISITOR_ID subjects,访客实验对象,实验访客数

definition: Count of distinct subject_id where subject type is STORE_ID (store-randomized experiments). Not merchant or user subjects.
scope_filter: experiment subject metrics; subject=STORE_ID; distinct subject_id
aliases: store subjects,STORE_ID subjects,门店实验对象,实验门店数

definition: Count of distinct subject_id assigned to the control bucket (assigned_bucket / assigned_bucket_name = control). Bucket-comparison recipe — pair with treatment for A/B denominators.
scope_filter: experiment subject metrics; assigned_bucket=control; distinct subject_id
aliases: control subjects,control bucket,对照组,对照组对象数,control arm

definition: Count of distinct subject_id assigned to a non-control treatment arm (test, show, hide, or other experiment-specific bucket codes). Use with an experiment_name filter; not the control arm.
scope_filter: experiment subject metrics; assigned_bucket in treatment/test/show/hide (non-control); distinct subject_id
aliases: treatment subjects,test bucket,实验组,实验组对象数,test arm

definition: Count of distinct subject_id on their first exposure day (relative_exposed_date = 0). Exposure-day recipe — not the full assigned population across later relative days.
scope_filter: experiment subject metrics; relative_exposed_date=0; distinct subject_id
aliases: first exposed subjects,exposure day 0,首曝对象,首次曝光对象数,day-0 subjects

definition: Count of feed-tile interaction detail rows at tile grain across the full action mix (impression, clicked, add_to_wishlist, remove_from_wishlist, add_to_cart). One logged multi-product event contributes one row per product tile. Includes bot traffic. Event-row count — not action-specific impression/click/wishlist/ATC counts, and not distinct users or sessions.
scope_filter: feed-tile interaction detail; all actions; includes bots
aliases: feed tile interactions, tile interactions, feed interactions, Feed交互, feed_tile_interactions

definition: Count of feed-tile interaction detail rows across the full action mix excluding likely bots (`likely_bot` = 'true'); rows with null `likely_bot` are kept. Quality-filtered denominator for user-behaviour analysis — still a tile-grain event count, not distinct users or sessions.
scope_filter: feed-tile interaction detail; all actions; likely_bot<>true OR likely_bot IS NULL
aliases: non-bot feed events, feed tile non-bot interactions, quality-filtered feed interactions, 剔bot Feed交互, 非机器人Feed交互

definition: Average of each merchant's average fulfillment/handling time on the merchant dimension snapshot. Resolve to merchant grain before averaging again; never sum across merchants or snapshot dates. Source unit may be days or seconds — normalize before comparing tables.
scope_filter: merchant dimension snapshot
aliases: avg fulfillment time, merchant fulfillment time, 备货时长, 处理时长, 履约时长, handling time

definition: Average of each merchant's trailing-30-day average fulfillment time on the merchant dimension snapshot. Resolve to merchant grain before averaging again; never sum. Reported in days.
scope_filter: merchant dimension snapshot; trailing 30 days; destination US
aliases: 30 day avg fulfillment time, us 30 day avg fulfillment time, 近30日备货时长, 美国近30日履约时长

definition: Average of additional fulfillment hours on merchant-transaction rows in the period. Transaction-grain average — not a merchant-snapshot attribute and not interchangeable with merchant_avg.
scope_filter: merchant transactions
aliases: avg additional fulfillment hours, additional fulfillment hours, 额外备货小时, 额外处理时长

definition: Sum of buyer merchandise GMV at commerce line, variation, product-day, user-day, or experiment-day grain: typically quantity × (paid_price + paid_shipping) or the stored gmv column. House default excludes Limited Time Deal lines. Additive over the grain; multi-currency and not FX-normalized. Not platform revenue, not refund dollars, not cart list price, and not net of refunds.
scope_filter: commerce purchase facts; excl LTD; excl is_testing when present; upstream often already drops pending/declined/exception/refund-before-pay and China-IP/bot noise
aliases: gmv,gross merchandise value,成交额,交易总额,gmv excl ltd,剔LTD GMV,去LTD成交额

definition: Same additive merchandise GMV sum as sum_excl_ltd, with Limited Time Deal lines kept. Broader unfiltered total — not interchangeable with the house excl-LTD default.
scope_filter: commerce purchase facts; include LTD; excl is_testing when present
aliases: gmv_w_ltd,gmv with ltd,含LTD GMV,含LTD成交额

definition: Sum of discount-adjusted actual GMV: line GMV after removing the proportional share of transaction discount_amount. Excludes LTD. Not the unadjusted merchandise GMV sum and not interchangeable with paid_amount.
scope_filter: commerce line facts; excl LTD; excl is_testing
aliases: actual_gmv,actual GMV,discount-adjusted GMV,实际GMV,实收成交额

definition: Same discount-adjusted actual GMV sum as sum_actual_excl_ltd, with LTD lines included.
scope_filter: commerce line facts; include LTD; excl is_testing
aliases: actual_gmv_w_ltd,actual GMV with LTD,含LTD实际GMV

definition: Average of line-grain GMV (AVG of paid_price + paid_shipping, or AVG of the line gmv formula). A mean over lines — never sum per-line averages as a period total. Split from the additive sum recipes.
scope_filter: commerce line facts; excl is_testing
aliases: avg_gmv,average GMV,mean line GMV,行均GMV,单均成交额

definition: Sum of line-grain merchandise GMV restricted to transactions in REFUNDED state (state 5). A state-filter recipe on GMV — not refund_amount dollars and not net GMV after refunds.
scope_filter: commerce line facts; state = REFUNDED (5); excl is_testing
aliases: refunded_gmv,refunded state GMV,已退款GMV,退款状态成交额

definition: Sum of the WE-scoped GMV subset at product-day grain. Bounded by unscoped product-day GMV — a scope recipe, not a different amount formula.
scope_filter: daily commerce product-day facts; WE-scoped subset
aliases: we_gmv,WE GMV,WE成交额,WE范围成交额

definition: Sum of variation-level GMV excluding LTD, with each variation's GMV capped at 200 (approx. 99.9th percentile). Experiment-robust capped recipe — not interchangeable with uncapped sum_excl_ltd.
scope_filter: payment-received variation lines; excl LTD; per-variation cap at 200; excl Wish Cash/BNPL special variations; excl pending/declined/exception; excl refunds before payment received
aliases: gmv_upto_p999,capped GMV,p999 GMV,封顶GMV,截断成交额

definition: Sum of lifetime cumulative GMV from experiment subject LTV maps (metric_sum_ltv_map). Cumulative-to-date through the experiment window — not the daily incremental GMV sum.
scope_filter: experiment subject metrics; LTV/cumulative map
aliases: gmv_ltv,lifetime GMV,cumulative GMV,终身GMV,累计成交额

definition: Sum of merchant-user-account annual_gmv as recorded on the current merchant_user dump. Merchant-grain snapshot — not additive over time; summing across dump dates double-counts the same account.
scope_filter: merchant_user account snapshot; annual_gmv attribute
aliases: annual_gmv,annual GMV,merchant annual GMV,商家年GMV,年成交额快照

definition: Sum of merchant-user-account preorder_gmv as recorded on the current merchant_user dump. Merchant-grain snapshot — not additive over time.

aliases: cumulative_onboarded_merchant_users, rolling onboarded merchants, 近30日累计入驻, 累计入驻商家账号数
