definition: Sum of power_days across ULC user-day or buyer-day snapshot rows on dt (NULL treated as 0). power_days counts distinct active calendar days in the rolling 28-day window ending on dt (DAU window for users; purchase-day window for buyers). Additive total — never average. Not the power-flag boolean day count, not loyal_cycles, not DAU headcount, and not the power-user share rate.
scope_filter: ulc_power_user, ulc_active_users, or ulc_active_buyers user/buyer×day facts
aliases: power days,power_days_total,sum of power_days,高活天数合计,重度活跃天数

definition: Average of power_days across user-day or buyer-day rows on dt. A duration mean over the snapshot grain — never sum means as a period total. Split from the additive sum. Values typically 1–28 when day_interval = 28.
scope_filter: ulc_power_user or ULC active user/buyer×day facts carrying power_days
aliases: power_days_average,avg power days,average power_days,高活天数均值,平均高活天数

definition: Sum of the power boolean at user×day or buyer×day grain (power_flag = 1, or power_days at threshold: >=10 for users, >=4 for buyers). Counts power user-days / power buyer-days — additive across days, not distinct power users or buyers over the window. Not the continuous power_days sum and not the power share rate.
scope_filter: ulc_active_users, ulc_power_user, or ulc_active_buyers; power_flag = 1 or power_days at threshold
aliases: power_user_days,power_buyer_days,power flag days,重度用户天,重度买家天,高活标记天

definition: Sum of the loyal boolean at user×day or buyer×day grain (loyal_flag = 1; loyal_cycles >= 2). Counts loyal user-days / loyal buyer-days — additive across days, not distinct loyal users or buyers over the window. Not loyal_cycles totals and not DAU headcount.
scope_filter: ulc_active_users or ulc_active_buyers; loyal_flag = 1
aliases: loyal_user_days,loyal_buyer_days,loyal flag days,忠诚用户天,忠诚买家天

definition: Sum of loyal_cycles across ULC active user-day or buyer-day rows on dt. Additive cycle count — never average. Not the loyal_flag day count and not power_days.
scope_filter: ulc_active_users or ulc_active_buyers user/buyer×day facts
aliases: loyal_cycles_total,sum of loyal_cycles,loyal cycles,忠诚周期合计,忠诚循环数

definition: Average inclusive calendar span (start_dt through end_dt) of packed ULC activity intervals. Packed rows may exceed 28 days. A duration mean over intervals — never sum; not interval row count and not power_days.
scope_filter: ulc_base_users packed intervals; user_id × start_dt grain; partition dt = end_dt
aliases: avg_interval_days,average interval days,activity interval days,活跃区间天数均值,区间跨度均值

definition: Sum of logged Product Boost revenue (`pb_revenue`) over feed-tile interaction detail rows. Tile grain: the same boosted tile contributes once per interaction row. Logged advertising revenue — not realized order GMV, not WishPost logistics sales, and not the click-only `pb_click_revenue` recipe.
scope_filter: feed-tile interaction detail; includes bots
aliases: product boost revenue,pb revenue,pb_revenue,PB收入,推广费收入,推广收入,boost revenue,ad revenue

definition: Sum of logged Product Boost click revenue (`pb_click_revenue`) over feed-tile interaction detail rows. Matches the documented Product Boost performance-query `total_revenue` measure. Click-revenue recipe — not interchangeable with the general `pb_revenue` sum, and not order GMV.
scope_filter: feed-tile interaction detail; includes bots
aliases: product boost click revenue,pb click revenue,pb_click_revenue,boost click revenue,PB点击收入,推广点击收入,total_revenue

definition: Sum of extra/additional photos attached to product listings in a single catalog snapshot partition. Listing photo volume at product grain — not distinct product count, not impression or rating volume, and not additive across snapshot dates (every partition repeats the catalog).
scope_filter: product catalog snapshot; single dt partition
aliases: extra photos,product photos,additional photos,商品附加图,num extra photos,photo count,total extra photos

definition: Count of distinct product_id (or _id) in the selected scope — catalog snapshot, sold/transaction lines, add-to-cart or feed engagement, ratings, order tracking, or warehouse-shipping snapshot depending on the model. One product is counted once; catalog snapshots are as-of and not additive across days. Not variation/SKU count and not units sold.
scope_filter: any products-root model; unfiltered distinct product_id
aliases: products, listings, distinct products, product count, SKUs at product level, 商品数, 在售商品数, 商品数量

definition: Row count at product grain when the source is already one row per product (dim_all_products / master_products within a single dt). Uses COUNT of rows, not COUNT DISTINCT; within one snapshot partition this equals distinct products. Point-in-time — not additive across snapshot dates.
scope_filter: product catalog snapshot; product-grain rows; single dt
aliases: product_rows, total_products, catalog product rows, 商品行数, 目录商品行数

definition: Count of distinct products that received at least one logged rating event in scope. Rating-event scope recipe on products — not review/rating document count.
scope_filter: product rating event facts; products with ≥1 rating log
aliases: distinct_rated_products, rated products, products with ratings, 有评分商品, 被评价商品数

definition: Count of distinct products whose listing state is ACTIVE on the catalog snapshot (model-specific state code / state_name). State filter recipe on the products root — not a separate root. Snapshot as-of, not additive across dt.
scope_filter: product catalog snapshot; state=ACTIVE
aliases: active_products, wt_active_products, ACTIVE listings, 在售商品, 上架商品数

definition: Count of distinct products flagged commerce_active = 1: product active, merchant active, and product not removed.
scope_filter: product catalog snapshot; commerce_active=1
aliases: commerce_active_products, commerce-active products, 可交易商品, 商业在售商品

definition: Count of distinct products that exist in the commerce system with valid data (has_commerce_product = 1).
scope_filter: product catalog snapshot; has_commerce_product=1
aliases: products_with_commerce_data, has commerce data products, 有商业数据商品, 已入商业系统商品

definition: Count of distinct products flagged content-clean (is_clean = 'true'). Content-moderation filter recipe on products.
scope_filter: product catalog snapshot; is_clean='true'
aliases: clean_products, clean listings, 洁净商品, 内容干净商品

definition: Count of distinct products flagged as adult (is_adult = 'true'). Content-moderation filter recipe on products.
scope_filter: product catalog snapshot; is_adult='true'
aliases: adult_products, adult listings, 成人商品, 成人内容商品

definition: Count of distinct products flagged as counterfeit (is_counterfeit = 'true'). Content-moderation filter recipe on products.
scope_filter: product catalog snapshot; is_counterfeit='true'
aliases: counterfeit_products, counterfeit listings, 假冒商品, 仿冒商品

definition: Count of distinct products flagged as deleted (is_deleted = 'true'). Content-moderation / state filter recipe on products.
scope_filter: product catalog snapshot; is_deleted='true'
aliases: deleted_products, deleted listings, 已删除商品, 删除商品数

definition: Count of distinct products flagged as verified (is_verified = 'true'). Content-moderation filter recipe on products.
scope_filter: product catalog snapshot; is_verified='true'
aliases: verified_products, verified listings, 已验证商品, 认证商品

definition: Count of distinct products flagged as consumer-to-consumer (is_c2c = 'true').
scope_filter: product catalog snapshot; is_c2c='true'
aliases: c2c_products, C2C listings, C2C商品, 个人卖家商品

definition: Count of distinct products flagged as top seller (is_top_seller = 'true').
scope_filter: product catalog snapshot; is_top_seller='true'
aliases: top_seller_products, top-seller listings, 畅销商品, 热卖商品

definition: Count of distinct products flagged as trending (is_trending_product = 'true').
scope_filter: product catalog snapshot; is_trending_product='true'
aliases: trending_products, trending listings, 趋势商品, 流行商品

definition: Count of distinct products blocked by Feed Processing (fp_review_status = 3 / BLOCKED). Feed-Processing review filter recipe on products.
scope_filter: product catalog snapshot; fp_review_status=3 BLOCKED
aliases: blocked_products, FP blocked products, Feed Processing blocked, FP拦截商品, 审核拦截商品

definition: Count of distinct products removed by the merchant (product_removed_by_merchant = 'true').
scope_filter: product catalog snapshot; product_removed_by_merchant='true'
aliases: merchant_removed_products, merchant-removed listings, 商家下架商品, 商户移除商品

definition: Count of distinct product_id sold or ordered on commerce / merchant transaction facts; a product on many lines is counted once. Default sold recipe excludes LTD when the model offers that split; LTD-inclusive sold is the same recipe with LTD kept. Not units sold.
scope_filter: commerce or merchant transaction line facts
aliases: unique_products_sold, products sold, unique_products_sold_w_ltd, 成交商品数, 有成交商品, 售出商品数

definition: Count of distinct product_id among add-to-cart events (or feed-tile ATC actions); a product added many times is counted once. Not ATC event count and not units added.
scope_filter: add-to-cart or feed-tile engagement facts
aliases: add_to_cart_products, ATC products, carted products, 加购商品数, 加购商品

definition: Sum of per-merchant active-product counters (num_active_products) across merchants in scope. Snapshot attribute sum — not additive over time across snapshot dates, and not count_distinct of product_id.
scope_filter: merchant dimension snapshot; sum num_active_products
aliases: num_active_products, summed active products by merchant, 商家在售商品合计, 活跃商品数合计

definition: Sum of per-order / per-parcel product_count over logistics parcel facts in scope — a SUM of product counts on parcels, not count_distinct products. Restrict to a single snapshot dt when the fact is a rolling window.
scope_filter: WishPost full-cycle parcel facts; sum product_count
aliases: product_count, summed products on parcels, 包裹商品数合计, 运单商品数合计

definition: Count of distinct ProductRating documents (Mongo `_id`) in the product-rating event log. Edits of the same document count once; prefer this over raw event rows for review volume. Not an average star value.
scope_filter: product-rating event log
aliases: distinct ratings, review count, 评价数, 评分数, rating count, 评价量, product reviews

definition: Count of distinct ProductRating documents excluding events flagged likely_fake. Like-for-like trusted review volume for products and merchants — still count_distinct, not event-row count.
scope_filter: product-rating event log; likely_fake=false
aliases: trusted distinct ratings, non-fake review count, 可信评价数, 非虚假评价数

definition: Count of distinct `(transaction_id, product_id)` review identities. Submission plus revisions of the same review count once; mirrors DailyProductRating dedup. Split from document `_id` distinct and from raw event rows.
scope_filter: product-rating event log
aliases: distinct rating identities, review identity count, 评价身份数, transaction-product reviews

definition: Row count of logged product-rating events (creates and edits). Over-counts reviews versus distinct docs/identities. Plain event-row COUNT — not count_distinct and not a snapshot counter sum.
scope_filter: product-rating event log
aliases: rating events, rating event count, 评价事件数, ratings received events

definition: Row count of logged rating events whose likely_fake flag is false. Trust-filtered event COUNT mirroring production rating pipelines — still event rows, not distinct reviews.
scope_filter: product-rating event log; likely_fake=false
aliases: trusted rating events, non-fake rating events, 可信评价事件, 非虚假评价事件数

definition: Row count of logged rating events whose likely_fake flag is true. Trust-bucket event COUNT — not distinct reviews and not the trusted complement.
scope_filter: product-rating event log; likely_fake=true
aliases: likely fake rating events, fake rating events, 疑似刷单评价事件, 刷单评价数

definition: Row count of logged rating events where edit is false — original submissions with no prior rating for the same `(transaction_id, product_id)`. First-submission filter recipe on event COUNT.
scope_filter: product-rating event log; edit=false
aliases: first rating events, first submissions, 首次评价事件, 初评事件数

definition: Row count of logged rating events where edit is true — revisions of an earlier submission for the same `(transaction_id, product_id)`. Edit-filter recipe on event COUNT.
scope_filter: product-rating event log; edit=true
aliases: rating edit events, revision events, 修改评价事件, 评价修订事件数

definition: Row count of logged rating events that carry a non-empty review body. Comment-filter recipe on event COUNT; star-only submissions log an empty comment.
scope_filter: product-rating event log; non-empty comment
aliases: rating events with comment, commented ratings, 带评论文本事件, 有正文评价事件

definition: Row count of logged rating events where left_comment is true — the rating already had a non-empty comment before this update. Separates edits to written reviews from star-only edits.
scope_filter: product-rating event log; left_comment=true
aliases: rating events left comment, prior-comment rating events, 曾留评评价事件, 已有评论评价事件

definition: Row count of logged rating events submitted through the native mobile rating prompt path (from_native_prompt true). Prompt-path filter recipe on event COUNT.
scope_filter: product-rating event log; from_native_prompt=true
aliases: native prompt rating events, from_native_prompt events, 原生提示评价事件, 原生评分弹窗事件

definition: Row count of logged rating events in a single star bucket (1, 2, 3, 4, or 5). Shared star-bucket filter recipe on event COUNT — parameterize by star; not distinct reviews and not the average star value.
scope_filter: product-rating event log; rating star in {1,2,3,4,5}
aliases: star bucket rating events, num_1..num_5, 分星级评价事件, 1-5星评价事件数

definition: Row count of logged rating events with 1 or 2 stars. Negative-signal star-bucket recipe mirroring DailyProductRating num_1_2 — event COUNT, not a rate.
scope_filter: product-rating event log; rating in {1,2}
aliases: low rating events, 1-2 star events, 低星评价事件, 差评事件数, num_1_2

definition: Sum of lifetime snapshot `rating_count` counters across merchants, products, or variations in scope. Point-in-time attribute sum — not additive across snapshot/dump dates; not event-log COUNT or count_distinct.
scope_filter: merchant, product, or variation catalog/dimension snapshot; lifetime rating_count
aliases: rating_count total, total_rating_count, wt_rating_count_total, 快照评价数合计, 累计评价数合计

definition: Sum of trailing-14-day snapshot rating counters (e.g. rating_count_14_days) across merchants in scope. Same snapshot-sum recipe with a 14-day window — still not additive across dump dates.
scope_filter: merchant dimension snapshot; trailing 14 days
aliases: rating_count_14_days, 14-day ratings received, 近14日评价数合计, 十四日评价数

definition: Share of logged product-rating events that are 1–2 star: low_rating_events / rating_events as a 0–1 fraction. Event-level ratio mirroring DailyProductRating num_1_2 — each create or edit log row counts again in both numerator and denominator; not a distinct-review or current-rating-per-key share, and not average star value.
scope_filter: product-rating event log; numerator rating in {1,2}
aliases: low rating rate,差评率,1-2 star share,low_rating_rate,event-level negative rating rate,num_1_2 share

definition: Share of logged product-rating events flagged likely_fake over all logged rating events as a 0–1 fraction. Event-level trust-signal ratio — revisions of the same rating recount; not distinct-review fake share and not low-star or edit/comment rates.
scope_filter: product-rating event log; numerator likely_fake=true
aliases: likely fake rating rate,fake rating rate,刷单率,疑似刷单占比,likely_fake_rating_rate

definition: Share of logged product-rating events that are revisions of an earlier rating (`edit` true) over all logged rating events as a 0–1 fraction. Event-level revision incidence — recounts edits; not first-submission share and not distinct-review or fake/comment rates.
scope_filter: product-rating event log; numerator edit=true
aliases: rating edit rate,评价修改率,edit rate,revision share,rating_edit_rate

definition: Share of logged product-rating events that carry a non-empty review body over all logged rating events as a 0–1 fraction. Event-level comment incidence — star-only submissions are excluded from the numerator; not distinct commented-review share and not low-star/fake/edit rates.
scope_filter: product-rating event log; numerator non-empty comment
aliases: comment rate,带评论率,review body share,commented rating share,comment_rate

definition: Sum of pre-aggregated in-app recommend or share request click event counters at product-day grain. Additive across products and days — five recommend clicks contribute five. Upstream bot/China-IP filters already applied on the commerce product-day fact. Never average; not an event-row count, not distinct recommenders, not wishlist wish-button clicks, and not browse clicks.
scope_filter: product-day recommend counters (e.g. recommends); upstream bot/China-IP filters already applied
aliases: recommends, recommend clicks, share recommends, in-app recommends, recommend via app, 推荐次数, 推荐次数合计

definition: Sum of buyer-facing refund dollars over refund lines, refund facts, or parcel rollups (`amount` / `refunded_amount`; where the contract applies, `refund_payment_amount + refund_cash_amount`). Transaction-fee legs excluded when tracked separately. Additive; USD or merchant currency depending on source — not FX-normalized across currencies. Not a refund count, refund rate, or fee-only amount.
scope_filter: commerce, merchant, or logistics refund facts; exclude is_testing
aliases: refund amount,refund dollars,refund GMV,total refunds,退款金额,退款总额,amount refunded

definition: Sum of buyer-facing refund dollars whose original-payment leg reached REFUND_ISSUED / Confirmed (PSP confirmed). Excludes pending, voided, not-paid, or denied legs. Narrower than unfiltered sum — not interchangeable with it.
scope_filter: refund items; payment leg status = REFUND_ISSUED or Confirmed; exclude is_testing
aliases: refund_amount_issued,confirmed_refund_amount,issued refund,已发放退款,确认退款金额

definition: Sum of transaction-fee dollars refunded along with the item (`refund_fee_amount`). Kept separate so refund-GMV definitions can include or exclude the fee explicitly — not the buyer merchandise/cash refund sum.
scope_filter: commerce refund line items; fee leg present; exclude is_testing
aliases: refund_fee_amount,refund fee,refunded transaction fee,退款手续费,退款费用

definition: Sum of refund dollars returned to the buyer's original external payment method (`refund_payment_amount` / coalesce(refund_payment_method,1)=1). Destination recipe — not Wish Cash, not store credit, and not the all-destination sum.
scope_filter: refund items; destination = original payment; exclude is_testing
aliases: refund_to_original_payment_amount,refund_payment_amount,original payment refund,原路退回,退回原支付

definition: Sum of refund dollars credited to the buyer's Wish Cash balance (`refund_cash_amount` / refund_payment_method = COMMERCE_CASH). Destination recipe — not original-payment refund and not store-credit refund.
scope_filter: refund items; destination = Wish Cash; exclude is_testing
aliases: refund_to_wish_cash_amount,refund_cash_amount,Wish Cash refund,退回Wish Cash,退回余额

definition: Sum of refund dollars credited to the buyer's store credit (`refund_credit_amount`). Destination recipe — not original-payment refund and not Wish Cash refund.
scope_filter: refund items; destination = store credit; exclude is_testing
aliases: refund_credit_amount,store credit refund,退回商店积分,积分退款

definition: Sum of refund amount on REFUNDED transactions only (`state` = 5); the table doc's `total_refunds` / `refunded_amount`. State filter recipe — narrower than the unfiltered sum across all transaction states.
scope_filter: commerce or merchant transaction facts; state = REFUNDED (5); exclude is_testing
aliases: refunded_amount,total_refunds,state-5 refund amount,已退款金额,退款完成金额

definition: Sum of logistics-specific refund amount rolled up over parcels in scope (`logistics_refund_amount`). Parcel/logistics recipe — not commerce refund-line merchandise dollars and not the fee-leg recipe. Restrict to a single dt when the source is a rolling snapshot.
scope_filter: WishPost full-cycle parcels; logistics refund rollup; single dt when snapshot
aliases: logistics_refund_amount,logistics refund,物流退款,物流退款金额

definition: Average refund amount per transaction (or refund-bearing unit) that carries a refund. A mean over refunding units — never sum per-row averages, and not interchangeable with the unfiltered sum of refund money.
scope_filter: transactions with a non-zero refund amount; exclude is_testing
aliases: avg_refund_amount,average refund,mean refund,单均退款,退款均值,avg refund amount

definition: Count of refund line items or refund event rows at refund-item grain (one row per CommerceTransactionRefundItem, MerchantTransactionRefundItem, or fct_refund event row). Additive row count — not a sum of partial-refund counters, not distinct refunded transactions, and not refunded dollars.
scope_filter: commerce or merchant refund-item / refund-event facts; exclude is_testing when present
aliases: refund items,refund events,refund lines,退款笔数,退款明细行数,退款事件数

definition: Count of refund line items still eligible to be disputed. Disputable-only scope filter on refund-item grain — ETL clears the flag for Unity/WishPost orders, refunds that already have a dispute payment, MMRP returns, and dispute reasons that cannot open a dispute. Not all refund items and not dispute-approved items.
scope_filter: merchant refund line items; disputable-eligible only; exclude is_testing when present
aliases: disputable_refund_items,disputable refunds,可争议退款,可开争议退款明细

definition: Count of refund line items with an approved dispute. Dispute-approved scope filter on refund-item grain — narrower than disputable-eligible and not the unfiltered refund-item count.
scope_filter: merchant refund line items; dispute approved; exclude is_testing when present
aliases: dispute_approved_refund_items,dispute approved refunds,争议通过退款,已批准争议退款明细

definition: Sum of the partial-refund event counter on merchant transactions. Additive volume via SUM of a counter field — not COUNT of refund-item rows, not distinct refunded transactions, and not a monetary refund amount.
scope_filter: merchant transaction facts; partial refunds; exclude is_testing when present
aliases: partial_refunds,partial refund count,部分退款次数,部分退款数

definition: Average calendar days from transaction creation (transaction_time) to refund completion (refunded_time) over refund facts. A duration mean — never sum days across refunds. Not refund amount, payment lag, or refund rate.
scope_filter: commerce refund facts (fct_refund); refunded events
aliases: refund lag,days to refund,refund completion days,avg refund lag,平均退款时长,退款时长,退款完成天数

definition: Share of merchant transactions that were refunded: refunded transactions / total orders as a 0–1 fraction. Numerator is refunded merchant transactions (typically state = REFUNDED / 5); denominator is all merchant orders in scope. A rate — never summed across cells or periods. Not refund dollars, refunded transaction count, or rating quality rate.
scope_filter: merchant transaction facts; numerator refunded; denominator all orders in scope; exclude is_testing
aliases: refund rate,退款率,share refunded,refund incidence,merchant refund rate

definition: Average of the refund risk score on each merchant transaction (or refund event) assessing refund-fraud / refund-abuse likelihood. A score — average it, do not sum; not refund amount, not refund rate, and not star rating.
scope_filter: merchant transaction facts; one row per m_transaction_id
aliases: avg refund risk score, average refund risk score, refund risk score, fraud refund score, 退款风险分, 平均退款风险分, 商户退款风险

definition: Count of distinct buyer-facing commerce transactions (transaction_id / c_transaction_id) that have at least one refund line or refund event. One checkout counted once even with many refund items or line rows. Not refund dollars, not refund-item row count, and not merchant-order grain.
scope_filter: commerce refund-item or refund-event facts; at least one refund; exclude is_testing when present
aliases: refunded orders,refunded transactions,退款订单数,orders with refund,distinct refunded checkouts

definition: Count of distinct buyer-facing commerce transactions in REFUNDED state (state = 5). State-filter recipe — typically fully refunded checkouts; not interchangeable with the has-refund-event distinct, and not a refund-item or dollar count.
scope_filter: commerce transaction facts; state = REFUNDED (5); exclude is_testing when present
aliases: refunded_orders,state-5 transactions,已退款订单,REFUNDED commerce transactions

definition: Count of distinct merchant transactions (m_transaction_id) that have at least one refund item. Merchant-order grain — one buyer checkout can split into several merchant orders, so this can exceed commerce refunded_transactions. Not refund dollars and not refund-item row count.
scope_filter: merchant refund-item facts; at least one refund item; exclude is_testing when present
aliases: refunded merchant orders,refunded m_transactions,退款商单数,merchant refunded transactions

member_zh: 已退款状态商家订单数
definition: Count of distinct merchant transactions in REFUNDED state (state = 5). State-filter merchant-order recipe — not interchangeable with the has-refund-item merchant distinct, and not buyer-facing commerce transaction count.
scope_filter: merchant transaction facts; state = REFUNDED (5); exclude is_testing when present
aliases: refunded merchant orders state 5,退款完成商单,REFUNDED merchant transactions

definition: Count of distinct merchant payments (payouts) that were charged for a refund item in scope. Refund items with no merchant payment are excluded. Payment-grain recipe — not merchant-transaction distinct and not commerce checkout distinct.
scope_filter: merchant refund-item facts; merchant payment present / charged for the refund; exclude is_testing when present
aliases: refunded_merchant_payments,merchant payments charged for refund,退款商户付款,refund payout count

definition: Sum of line-grain paid_price — the merchandise amount the buyer paid for the line, excluding buyer-paid shipping. House default drops Limited Time Deal lines. Additive over commerce line rows. Multi-currency; not FX-adjusted. Not GMV, not platform raw_revenue take, and not shipping revenue.
scope_filter: commerce line facts; excl LTD; excl is_testing when present
aliases: revenue,merchandise revenue,paid_price,paid price,商品收入,货款收入,实付货款,销售收入

definition: Same line-grain paid_price merchandise sum as sum_paid_price_excl_ltd, with Limited Time Deal lines kept. Unfiltered variant — not interchangeable with the house excl-LTD default.
scope_filter: commerce line facts; include LTD; excl is_testing when present
aliases: revenue_w_ltd,revenue with ltd,merchandise revenue with ltd,含LTD商品收入,含LTD实付货款

definition: Sum of marketplace platform take (raw_revenue / raw_revenue_variation) at variation or buyer-day grain after attributed costs and taxes per source, excluding Limited Time Deal. Platform take dollars — not paid_price merchandise revenue and not full GMV.
scope_filter: payment-received commerce variation or buyer-day facts; excl LTD; excl Wish Cash/BNPL special variations; excl pending/declined/exception; excl refunds before payment received
aliases: raw_revenue,raw_revenue_variation,platform revenue,marketplace take,平台营收,抽成金额,平台收入

definition: Same platform-take raw_revenue_variation sum as sum_raw_excl_ltd, with Limited Time Deal lines kept (raw_revenue_w_ltd). Broader unfiltered variant — not interchangeable with the excl-LTD recipe.
scope_filter: payment-received commerce variation lines; include LTD; excl Wish Cash/BNPL special variations; excl pending/declined/exception; excl refunds before payment received
aliases: raw_revenue_w_ltd,revenue_w_ltd (platform),platform revenue with ltd,含LTD平台营收,含LTD抽成

definition: Sum of excluding-LTD raw_revenue_variation keeping only rows with revenue at or below ~40 (approx. 99.9th percentile) before summing. Outlier-capped EXP recipe — not uncapped sum_raw_excl_ltd.
scope_filter: payment-received variation lines; excl LTD; row revenue<=40; excl Wish Cash/BNPL special variations; excl pending/declined/exception; excl refunds before payment received
aliases: raw_revenue_999,capped platform revenue,p999 revenue,封顶抽成,封顶平台营收

definition: Sum of the transaction-level pre-shipping, pre-tax merchandise subtotal (order_subtotal / subtotal). Value is repeated on every line of the same transaction, so collapse to one row per transaction_id before summing. Not line-grain paid_price and not the full order total.
scope_filter: commerce transaction facts; excl is_testing
aliases: order_subtotal,order subtotal,pre-tax subtotal,订单小计,商品小计,折前小计

definition: Sum of original or list merchandise price before discounts (original_price) at merchant-transaction grain. Pre-discount list basis — not paid_price, not product_price when those differ, and not rev-share dollars.
scope_filter: merchant transactions; excl is_testing
aliases: original_price,list price,pre-discount price,原始标价,折前标价,原价合计

definition: Sum of line product price (product_price) at merchant-transaction grain. Merchandise price basis — related to paid_price revenue but not buyer-paid GMV and not shipping.
scope_filter: merchant transactions; excl is_testing
aliases: product_price,product price,商品价格,产品价格,商品标价

definition: Sum of original revenue-share amount (original_rev_share) at merchant-transaction grain. Merchant-side share at original contractual terms — platform-take-adjacent dollars, not the updated_rev_share recipe and not a take_rate average.
scope_filter: merchant transactions; excl is_testing
aliases: original_rev_share,original rev share,原始分成,原始商家分成

definition: Sum of updated revenue-share amount (updated_rev_share) at merchant-transaction grain. Post-update merchant share dollars — not interchangeable with original_rev_share.
scope_filter: merchant transactions; excl is_testing
aliases: updated_rev_share,updated rev share,更新分成,更新后商家分成

definition: Average merchant/list merchandise price per variation in a catalog snapshot (AVG of merchant_price). A mean over mixed currencies — never sum; split from additive paid_price / product_price / original_price sums.
scope_filter: product-variation catalog snapshot; single dt partition
aliases: avg_price,average price,average merchant price,目录均价,均标价,平均商品价

definition: Sum of net order merchandise value (paid_price − discount_amount) over parcels or lines in scope. Discount-net merchandise recipe — not unadjusted paid_price and not full GMV.
scope_filter: WishPost full-cycle parcels or commerce lines carrying paid_price and discount; single dt when snapshot-scoped; excl is_testing
aliases: order_value,net order value,paid_price minus discount,净订单额,折后商品额

definition: Sum of customer paid_amount swept onto WishPost parcels from commerce facts. Restrict to a single snapshot dt — rolling windows re-emit parcels across partitions. Buyer-outlay adjacent to paid_price merchandise revenue — not WishPost logistics fee revenue.
scope_filter: WishPost full-cycle parcel snapshot; single dt
aliases: paid_amount,customer paid amount,买家实付,包裹实付额

definition: Sum of session duration (elapsed time spent in session) at user-day, session, or experiment-subject-day grain for the reporting day. Additive total time-in-session — includes daily values from experiment metric_sum_map['session_duration']. Never average; not a session count and not power or loyal activity days.
scope_filter: user/session/experiment-subject day facts carrying session duration
aliases: session duration,daily session duration,total session time,time in session,会话时长合计,日会话时长

definition: Average session duration (mean elapsed time per session or per subject-day) over the reporting scope. A duration mean — never sum means as a period total. Split from the additive sum. Not a session count and not power or loyal activity days.
scope_filter: user/session/experiment-subject day facts carrying session duration
aliases: avg session duration,average session length,mean time in session,会话时长均值,平均会话时长

definition: Count of distinct session_id with at least one feed-tile or similar engagement interaction in the window. One session with many tile events still counts once — not DAU, not distinct users, and not an event-row count. Includes bot traffic unless a quality member is used.
scope_filter: feed-tile or similar engagement detail; distinct session_id; includes bots
aliases: sessions,user sessions,feed sessions,会话数,去重会话数,feed_tile_sessions

definition: Count of distinct session_id with feed-tile or similar engagement activity, excluding likely bots and temporary users. Quality-filtered counterpart of the default distinct-session recipe — still count_distinct of sessions, not event rows or DAU.
scope_filter: feed-tile or similar engagement detail; distinct session_id; likely_bot<>true; is_temporary_user<>true
aliases: non-bot sessions,quality-filtered sessions,剔bot会话,非机器人会话数

definition: Count of shipment or tracking-record rows at OTI or WishPost parcel-row grain (one row per tracking record or first-mile parcel snapshot row). Not an order count and not a distinct tracking_id count.
scope_filter: order tracking or WishPost parcel facts
aliases: total shipments, tracking record count, parcel row count, 发货单数, 物流跟踪记录数, 发货量, 包裹行数

definition: Count of distinct tracking_id among OTI or WishPost first-mile parcels; the same id re-emitted across partitions counts once. Lower than tracking_created when ids repeat. Split from row count.
scope_filter: order tracking or WishPost parcel facts
aliases: unique tracking ids, distinct parcels, 去重运单数, 唯一运单数, 去重包裹数

definition: Count of tracking records with confirmed or valid tracking (`is_confirmed` / equivalently `is_valid_tracking`). Standard denominator of delivery and failure rates.
scope_filter: order tracking; confirmed or valid tracking
aliases: confirmed shipments, valid tracking shipments, 确认运单数, 有效运单数

definition: Count of tracking records or WishPost parcels marked delivered (`is_delivered` or delivered checkpoint present). Delivered-only filter; not restricted to confirmed.
scope_filter: order tracking or WishPost parcels; delivered
aliases: delivered shipments, delivered parcels, 妥投包裹数, 签收运单数, 送达运单数

definition: Count of tracking records that are both confirmed and delivered. Numerator of delivery rate over confirmed shipments.
scope_filter: order tracking; confirmed and delivered
aliases: confirmed delivered shipments, 确认妥投运单数, 确认签收运单数

definition: Count of tracking records with a delivery-failure checkpoint (ATTEMPT_FAIL or EXCEPTION).
scope_filter: order tracking; delivery failure
aliases: failed deliveries, 配送失败运单数, 派送失败运单数

definition: Count of tracking records that are both confirmed and failed delivery. Numerator of failure rate over confirmed shipments.
scope_filter: order tracking; confirmed and delivery failure
aliases: confirmed failed deliveries, 确认失败运单数, 确认配送失败运单数

definition: Count of commerce line items in SHIPPED order state (order_state 3) on the transaction fact. Line grain, not order or tracking-record grain.
scope_filter: commerce line facts; order_state=SHIPPED
aliases: shipped line items, 已发货明细行数, 发货行数

definition: Count of commerce line items whose parcel is delivered (`is_delivered`) on the transaction fact. Line grain, not order or tracking-record grain.
scope_filter: commerce line facts; delivered
aliases: delivered line items, 妥投明细行数, 签收行数

definition: Sum of pre-combination parcel or tracking counts (`pre_tracking_id_cnt` or deduped pre_tracking volume) over WishPost finance or purchase-breakdown cells. Additive volume — sum, never average. Not post-combine.
scope_filter: WishPost finance P&L or purchase-breakdown cells; pre-combine
aliases: pre tracking, pre-combine volume, first-mile volume, 合包前包裹数, 合包前运单量, FM volume

definition: Sum of post-combination parcel or tracking counts (`post_tracking_id_cnt`) over WishPost finance cells. Additive volume — sum, never average. Not pre-combine and not a distinct post-id count.
scope_filter: WishPost finance P&L cells; post-combine
aliases: post tracking, post-combine volume, combined parcels, 合包后包裹数, 合包后运单量

definition: Count of distinct post-combine tracking_id (last-mile combined shipments). Absent for standalone parcels never combined. Split from sum of post volume.
scope_filter: WishPost full-cycle parcels; post tracking present
aliases: last mile parcels, distinct post tracking, 合包后去重运单数, 末程合包运单数

definition: Sum of sales-side parcel volume (distinct sales tracking_ids per cell), including immature parcels. Maturity-rate denominator. Additive — sum, never average.
scope_filter: WishPost sales-breakdown cells; all sales trackings
aliases: sales volume, tracking volume, 销售运单量, 销售包裹量

definition: Sum of mature sales-side parcel volume — parcels whose purchase-side costs have landed. Fee-per-parcel denominator instead of raw volume. Additive — sum, never average.
scope_filter: WishPost sales-breakdown cells; mature purchase costs landed
aliases: volume mature, mature parcels, 成熟运单量, 成熟包裹量

definition: Count of parcels flagged as including Unity products (`is_unity_order`). Filtered parcel or shipment count, not a product or SKU count.
scope_filter: WishPost parcels; Unity products
aliases: has unity order, unity parcels, Unity包裹数, Unity运单数

definition: Average of star values (1–5 or 0–5) across logged rating events, or mean of entity-level average_rating attributes (merchant, product, or variation) in scope. Default business recipe — average the scores, never sum them as a total. Not rating_count and not min/max.
scope_filter: rating events or merchant/product/variation average_rating attributes
aliases: average rating,avg rating,star rating,平均评分,平均星级,product rating,merchant rating

definition: Average of trailing-14-day entity average_rating (e.g. merchant average_rating_14_days) across entities in scope. Same average recipe with a 14-day window — still a mean of scores, not additive across dump dates.
scope_filter: merchant (or entity) dimension snapshot; trailing 14 days
aliases: average_rating_14_days,14-day average rating,近14日平均评分,十四日评分

definition: Average of display-version entity average_rating across merchants in scope. Display-field average recipe — still a mean of scores, not the overall/lifetime average_rating field.
scope_filter: merchant dimension snapshot; display-version average_rating
aliases: average_rating_display,display average rating,展示评分,展示平均星级

definition: Average of 1–5 star values across logged rating events excluding likely_fake. Trust-filtered event-level mean — still average, not rating_count.
scope_filter: product-rating event log; likely_fake=false
aliases: avg rating not likely fake,trusted average rating,可信平均评分,非虚假平均星级

definition: Sum of 1–5 star values across logged rating events. Additive star total — edits recount; never average. Split from avg; not rating_count.
scope_filter: product-rating event log
aliases: sum_rating,sum of ratings,星级合计,评分总和

definition: Maximum 1–5 star value across logged rating events in scope. Extreme-value recipe — not average, sum, or rating_count.
scope_filter: product-rating event log
aliases: max_rating,maximum rating,最高评分,最高星级

definition: Minimum 1–5 star value across logged rating events in scope. Extreme-value recipe — not average, sum, or rating_count.
scope_filter: product-rating event log
aliases: min_rating,minimum rating,最低评分,最低星级

definition: Platform revenue divided by GMV over the same payment-received commerce activity, both sides excluding limited-time-deal lines under the house LTD convention. Covers buyer-day and variation-line grains that share this ratio. WBR topline take rate / margin alias. A rate — never summed across periods.
scope_filter: payment-received commerce; excl LTD; same-scope revenue and GMV; excl Wish Cash and BNPL special variations; excl pending/declined/exception; excl refunds before payment received
aliases: margin, take rate, WBR take rate, WBR margin, 变现率, 抽成率, 抽佣率, revenue over gmv

definition: Average of the merchant contractual revenue-share rate across merchants (or merchant users) in scope; normalize 0–1 decimals and 0–100 percents onto one scale before comparing. Snapshot attribute — average it, never sum.
scope_filter: merchant or merchant-user dimension snapshot in scope
aliases: rev share, revenue share, contractual rev share, 商家分成率, 收入分成比例

definition: Average of the promotional ERP revenue-share rate across merchant users in scope. A rate — average it, never sum.
scope_filter: merchant users in scope
aliases: erp promo rev share, promotional revenue share, ERP促销收入分成

member_zh: 商家承担成本比例均值
definition: Average of merchant eat-cost ratio (`merchant_responsible_amount / merchant_amount`) over merchant transactions in scope. Weighted cost-responsibility rate — average it, never sum.
scope_filter: merchant transactions with responsibility amounts
aliases: eat cost ratio, avg eat cost ratio, merchant eat cost, 商家承担成本比例, 吃进成本比例

definition: Unweighted average share of refund cost borne by the merchant over refund items in scope (1.0 = merchant fully responsible, 0.0 = Wish fully responsible). Differs from the weighted `merchant_responsible_amount / merchant_amount` eat-cost ratio — average it, never sum.
scope_filter: merchant refund-line items in scope
aliases: avg merchant responsibility, merchant responsibility share, 商家退款责任比例, 商家责任均值

definition: Sum of tax charged to the buyer on a commerce order (tax_amount). On line-grain sources the value is repeated on every line of the same transaction, so collapse to one row per transaction_id before summing. Multi-currency; not exchange-rate adjusted. Not tax_cost, tax_fee, processor_fee, or refund-remitted tax.
scope_filter: commerce transaction facts; exclude is_testing
aliases: tax amount,sales tax,VAT charged,税费,税额,buyer tax,tax charged

definition: Sum of variation-allocated tax excluding limited-time-deal lines (raw_total_tax). Proportionally allocated by (paid_price + paid_shipping) / (subtotal + total_shipping); additive at variation grain. Not interchangeable with the transaction-collapse tax_amount recipe.
scope_filter: paid commerce variation lines; excl LTD; excl Wish Cash/BNPL special variations; excl pending/declined/exception; excl refunds before payment received; exclude is_testing
aliases: raw_total_tax,tax excl LTD,variation tax,变体税费,不含LTD税费

definition: Same variation-grain tax sum as sum_excl_ltd, with limited-time-deal lines kept (raw_total_tax_w_ltd). Broader unfiltered variant — not interchangeable with the excl-LTD recipe.
scope_filter: paid commerce variation lines; incl LTD; excl Wish Cash/BNPL special variations; excl pending/declined/exception; excl refunds before payment received; exclude is_testing
aliases: raw_total_tax_w_ltd,tax with LTD,含LTD税费,含LTD税额

definition: Sum of the tax cost component (tax_cost) borne as cost basis rather than buyer-charged tax. On line-grain commerce sources collapse to one row per transaction_id before summing. Not the buyer-facing tax_amount and not the tax processing fee.
scope_filter: commerce or merchant transaction facts; exclude is_testing
aliases: tax cost,tax_cost,税费成本,税额成本

definition: Sum of the tax processing fee component (tax_fee). On line-grain sources collapse to one row per transaction_id before summing. Fee recipe — not buyer-charged tax_amount, not tax_cost, and not payment processor_fee.
scope_filter: commerce transaction facts; exclude is_testing
aliases: tax fee,tax_fee,tax processing fee,税费手续费,税额手续费

definition: Sum of the payment processor fee (processor_fee). Transaction-level value repeated on every line row — collapse to one row per transaction_id before summing or the fee over-counts. Payment-rail fee — not tax_fee and not buyer-charged tax_amount.
scope_filter: commerce transaction facts; exclude is_testing
aliases: processor fee,payment fee,processor_fee,支付处理费,支付手续费

definition: Sum of merchant-side tax amount (merchant_tax_amount) at merchant-transaction grain. Merchant tax basis — not buyer-charged commerce tax_amount and not tax remitted on refund lines.
scope_filter: merchant transactions; exclude is_testing
aliases: merchant_tax_amount,merchant tax,商家税费,商户税额

definition: Sum of tax dollars paid out with the merchant payment (merchant_payment_tax_amount). Payout-leg recipe — not the standing merchant_tax_amount balance and not buyer-charged tax.
scope_filter: merchant transactions; exclude is_testing
aliases: merchant_payment_tax_amount,tax paid with merchant payment,商户付款税费,付款税额

definition: Sum of tax remitted on refunded lines (merchant_tax_amount / refund_tax). Refund-leg remittance — not the original order tax_amount charge and not tax_cost/tax_fee.
scope_filter: commerce or merchant refund line items; exclude is_testing
aliases: refund_tax,merchant_tax remitted,refund remitted tax,退款税费,退款已缴税

definition: Sum of the last recorded payment-error amount on merchant-user accounts in scope. Account-snapshot monetary attribute as of the dump — not time-additive across dump dates and not commerce tax_amount or processor_fee.
scope_filter: merchant user account snapshot
aliases: payment error amount,payment_error_amount,支付错误金额,支付失败金额

definition: Average of each merchant's average customer-support ticket response time on the merchant dimension snapshot (source unit: seconds). Resolve to merchant grain before averaging again; never sum across merchants or snapshot dates. Ticket response only — not fulfillment, shipping, or delivery transit.
scope_filter: merchant dimension snapshot
aliases: avg ticket response time, support response time, 客服响应时间, 工单响应时长, ticket response time

definition: Average observed transit or blended calendar days from shipment, order, or tracking-record creation to confirmed delivery over delivered parcels or lines. Duration mean only — never sum days. Not a merchant-snapshot shipping attribute, not a catalog min/max promise, and not fulfillment time before ship.
scope_filter: delivered parcels or lines with confirmed delivery
aliases: avg ttd, avg delivery days, blended ttd, transit days, avg shipping time observed, 妥投天数, 平均妥投时长, 物流时长

definition: Average business days to arrival on merchant-transaction rows. Business-day clock — not interchangeable with calendar-day avg and not a merchant-snapshot attribute. Average only; never sum.
scope_filter: merchant transactions; arrived/delivered
aliases: avg business days to arrival, business days to delivery, 妥投工作日, 到达工作日, 工作日妥投时长

definition: Average of each merchant's average shipping or delivery time on the merchant dimension snapshot. Resolve to merchant grain before averaging again; never sum across merchants or snapshot dates. Source unit may be days or seconds — normalize before comparing tables.
scope_filter: merchant dimension snapshot
aliases: avg shipping time, merchant shipping time, merchant delivery time, 商家物流时长, 商家妥投时长, 商家发货时长

definition: Average of each merchant's trailing-30-day average delivery time on the merchant dimension snapshot. Resolve to merchant grain before averaging again; never sum. Reported in days.
scope_filter: merchant dimension snapshot; trailing 30 days; destination US
aliases: us 30 day avg delivery time, 30 day avg delivery, 近30日妥投时长, 美国近30日妥投时长

definition: Average of per-variation maximum shipping-time promises in days on the product-variation catalog snapshot. Catalog estimate upper bound — not observed transit and not min shipping time. Point-in-time snapshot average; never sum across snapshot dates.
scope_filter: product variation catalog snapshot
aliases: avg max shipping time, maximum shipping days, 最大物流天数, 最长发货时长

member_zh: 款式最短物流时长均值
definition: Average of per-variation minimum shipping-time promises in days on the product-variation catalog snapshot. Catalog estimate lower bound — not observed transit and not max shipping time. Point-in-time snapshot average; never sum across snapshot dates.
scope_filter: product variation catalog snapshot
aliases: avg min shipping time, minimum shipping days, 最小物流天数, 最短发货时长

definition: Count of commerce or variation line-item rows at transaction×variation grain (COUNT(*) of lines). One checkout contributes several lines, so this exceeds distinct transaction count. Uses count of rows — not count_distinct of transaction_id, not sum of quantity, and no LTD include/exclude rule. Not buyer checkouts, not merchant orders, and not units sold.
scope_filter: commerce or variation line facts at txn×variation grain; excl is_testing when present
aliases: transaction lines,variation lines,line items,order lines,订单行数,行项目数,line count

definition: Count of payment-received variation lines excluding limited-time-deal items. WBR topline line-count denominator (count(*)); at this grain matches count_distinct(transaction_id, variation_id). House excl-LTD recipe — not interchangeable with the LTD-inclusive or unfiltered line counts, and not distinct checkout or merchant-order count.
scope_filter: payment-received variation lines; exclude LTD; excl Wish Cash and BNPL special variations; excl pending/declined/exception; excl refunds before payment received
aliases: variation_lines,variation lines excl LTD,WBR line count,剔LTD订单行,去LTD行数,num_of_order lines

definition: Count of payment-received variation lines including limited-time-deal items. Same commerce scope as excl_ltd with LTD kept — not interchangeable with the house excl-LTD or unfiltered line counts.
scope_filter: payment-received variation lines; include LTD; excl Wish Cash and BNPL special variations; excl pending/declined/exception; excl refunds before payment received
aliases: variation_lines_w_ltd,variation lines with LTD,含LTD订单行,含LTD行数

definition: Count of distinct buyer-facing commerce checkouts (transaction_id / c_transaction_id). One checkout counted once even when it spans many variation lines or merchant orders. No LTD include/exclude rule and no payment-received gate unless the source already applied one. Not merchant-order count, not units, and not a SUM of pre-aggregated txn counters.
scope_filter: commerce or merchant transaction facts; exclude is_testing when present
aliases: transactions,commerce transactions,checkouts,成交订单数,订单数(买家单),成交笔数,下单量,number of transactions

definition: Count of distinct commerce checkouts with payment received, excluding limited-time-deal (LTD) products. House payment-received recipe — not interchangeable with the LTD-inclusive count or the unfiltered distinct.
scope_filter: payment-received variation lines; exclude LTD; excl Wish Cash and BNPL special variations; excl pending/declined/exception; excl refunds before payment received
aliases: transactions excl LTD,checkouts excl LTD,去LTD交易数,剔LTD成交订单数,payment-received orders excl LTD

definition: Count of distinct commerce checkouts with payment received, including limited-time-deal (LTD) products. Same commerce scope as excl_ltd with LTD kept.
scope_filter: payment-received variation lines; include LTD; excl Wish Cash and BNPL special variations; excl pending/declined/exception; excl refunds before payment received
aliases: transactions_w_ltd,transactions with LTD,checkouts with payment received,含LTD交易数,含LTD成交订单数

definition: Count of distinct commerce transactions with at least one logged product-rating event. Rating-incidence recipe — not review/document count and not all purchase checkouts.
scope_filter: product rating event log; trust filters (likely_fake=false) when present
aliases: distinct_rated_transactions,rated transactions,有评价订单数,被评价交易数

definition: Count of distinct commerce transactions among order-tracking records. One transaction can carry several tracking rows, so this is lower than shipment count — not a tracking-record or parcel count.
scope_filter: order tracking facts
aliases: distinct_transactions,tracked transactions,有运单交易数,有物流订单数,transactions with tracking

definition: Sum of per-buyer payment-day distinct transaction counts when the source is already aggregated to user×day (txns). Uses SUM of the pre-counted column, not COUNT DISTINCT of transaction_id. Non-LTD purchase activity. Summing across days yields transaction-days totals equivalent only when each checkout maps to one buyer-day.
scope_filter: daily buyer user×day facts; non-LTD purchase activity; pre-aggregated txn counts
aliases: sum of daily txns,buyer-day transactions,买家日成交笔数合计,用户日交易数合计

definition: Sum of same-day per-user distinct transaction counts on the attribution day (MDE last-touch). Purchase/txn side excludes LTD upstream. Attributed checkout volume — not unattributed payment-day buyer txns and not COUNT DISTINCT of raw transaction_id.
scope_filter: dau_attribution user×day; same-day purchase txn counts; excl LTD upstream
aliases: num_txn,same-day attributed transactions,归因当日交易数,当日成交笔数

definition: Sum of cumulative lifetime experiment order/transaction counters (metric_sum_ltv_map orders). Pre-aggregated subject-level lifetime volume — not period COUNT DISTINCT of checkout ids and not daily incremental order counts.
scope_filter: experiment subject metrics; cumulative LTV order counters
aliases: orders_ltv,lifetime orders,LTV orders,experiment lifetime orders,实验终身订单数,累计实验订单数

definition: Sum of purchased item quantity at commerce line, merchant-transaction, or product-day grain (quantity / purchases / mid_cnt). Additive unit volume — sum quantity, never average it, never treat as distinct orders or products, and never mix with a monetary amount. No special LTD include/exclude rule.
scope_filter: commerce/merchant/product-day purchase facts; exclude is_testing when present
aliases: units sold,quantity,purchases,purchased units,mid_cnt,售出件数,销量件数,件数

definition: Sum of quantity sold on payment-received variation lines, excluding limited-time-deal items. Same additive unit-count recipe as sum, with the house LTD exclusion.
scope_filter: payment-received variation lines; exclude LTD; excl Wish Cash and BNPL special variations; excl pending/declined/exception; excl refunds before payment received
aliases: quantity excl LTD,units sold excl LTD,去LTD售出件数,剔LTD件数

definition: Sum of quantity sold on payment-received variation lines, keeping limited-time-deal items. Same commerce scope as sum_excl_ltd, with LTD lines included.
scope_filter: payment-received variation lines; include LTD; excl Wish Cash and BNPL special variations; excl pending/declined/exception; excl refunds before payment received
aliases: quantity_w_ltd,units sold with LTD,含LTD售出件数,含LTD件数

definition: Sum of refunded item quantity at refund-line or merchant-transaction grain (refund_quantity / refunded_quantity). Additive unit count of items covered by FULL and PARTIAL_QUANTITY refunds — not a monetary refund amount and not an order count.
scope_filter: commerce or merchant refund lines / merchant transactions with refunded quantity; FULL and PARTIAL_QUANTITY refunds
aliases: refund quantity,refunded units,refunded_quantity,退款件数,退货件数

definition: Sum of product- or variation-level catalog purchase_count across products or variations in a single snapshot partition. Cumulative-to-date contest/catalog purchase counts as-of the snapshot — not purchases in a filtered period; never sum across snapshot dates.
scope_filter: product or variation catalog snapshot; single dt partition
aliases: purchase_count,purchase count total,total purchases,catalog purchase count,目录累计销量,累计购买件数

definition: Sum of item quantity swept onto WishPost parcels or logistics sales-breakdown cells within a single snapshot partition. Restrict to one dt — rolling windows re-emit parcels/cells across consecutive partitions, so multi-dt sums over-count. Not maturity-gated.
scope_filter: WishPost full-cycle parcel or logistics sales-breakdown snapshot; single dt
aliases: parcel quantity,wishpost quantity,mid_cnt,包裹件数,物流件数

definition: Count of distinct user_id in the user master — the total registered user base unless a registration-cohort (dt) cut is applied. One row per user forever; not DAU and not buyers.
scope_filter: user master; unfiltered distinct user_id
aliases: users, registered users, user accounts, 注册用户, 用户数, 注册用户数

definition: Row count at user grain on the user master (COUNT of rows). Equals distinct users when user_id is unique; use when the measure is a row count rather than count_distinct of user_id.
scope_filter: user master; user-grain rows
aliases: user_rows, user row count, 用户行数, 注册用户行数

definition: Users registered on the day of the time bucket: COUNT(*) grouped by registration dt (Daily New User Registration). Registration-cohort recipe — not the cumulative user base and not DAU.
scope_filter: user master; registration-day cohort
aliases: new users, new registrations, daily new users, 新增用户, 新注册用户, 日新增注册

definition: Count of distinct users whose account status is Registered (status 3) — verified users plus Google / Apple / Facebook signups and non-verification-eligible users.
scope_filter: user master; user_status=Registered (3)
aliases: registered_users, Registered status users, 已注册用户, Registered状态用户

definition: Count of distinct users whose account status is Unprocessed (status 1) — newly created email / phone users still eligible for verification.
scope_filter: user master; user_status=Unprocessed (1)
aliases: unprocessed_users, Unprocessed status users, 未处理用户, 待验证用户

definition: Count of distinct users whose account status is Deleted (status 6). These users can be restored if they sign in again.
scope_filter: user master; user_status=Deleted (6)
aliases: deleted_users, Deleted status users, 已删除用户, 注销用户

definition: Count of distinct users flagged as verified (`is_verified`).
scope_filter: user master; is_verified=true
aliases: verified_users, verified accounts, 已验证用户, 验证用户

definition: Count of distinct users flagged as Wish Stars (`is_wish_star`).
scope_filter: user master; is_wish_star=true
aliases: wish_star_users, Wish Star users, Wish Star用户

definition: Count of distinct users flagged as likely bots (`likely_bot`). Quantified so the population can be subtracted; table docs recommend excluding from business metrics. Model output known to mis-flag some legitimate users.
scope_filter: user master; likely_bot=true
aliases: bot_users, likely bot users, 疑似机器人用户, bot用户

definition: Count of distinct users flagged as temporary accounts (`is_temporary`). Quantified so the population can be subtracted from permanent-user analysis.
scope_filter: user master; is_temporary=true
aliases: temporary_users, temporary accounts, 临时用户, 临时账号

definition: Count of distinct variation_id (SKU) in the selected scope — catalog snapshot, commerce/merchant transaction lines, refund lines, add-to-cart events, order tracking, or product-rating events depending on the model. One variation is counted once; catalog snapshots are as-of and not additive across days. Finer than product count; not units sold.
scope_filter: any variations-root model; unfiltered distinct variation_id
aliases: variations, SKUs, distinct variations, number of skus, 规格数, SKU数, 变体数

definition: Row count at variation grain on the product-variation catalog snapshot (COUNT of rows for the filtered dt). Equals distinct variations within a single partition; use when the measure is COUNT(*) rather than count_distinct of variation_id. Point-in-time — not additive across snapshot dates.
scope_filter: product variation catalog snapshot; variation-grain rows; single dt
aliases: variation_count, catalog variation rows, 目录SKU行数, 变体行数, 规格行数

definition: Count of variation rows in the catalog snapshot with enabled = 'true'. Filtered catalog count (COUNT), not a separate entity; snapshot is as-of and not additive across dt.
scope_filter: product variation catalog snapshot; enabled='true'
aliases: enabled_variation_count, enabled variations, 可售SKU, 已启用变体, 上架规格数

definition: Count of variation rows in the catalog snapshot with is_fbw_item = 'true' (fulfilled by Wish). Program-filtered catalog count; snapshot as-of, not additive across dt.
scope_filter: product variation catalog snapshot; is_fbw_item='true'
aliases: fbw_variation_count, FBW variations, Wish fulfilled SKUs, FBW规格数, FBW变体数

definition: Count of variation rows in the catalog snapshot with variation_removed = 'true'. State-filtered catalog count; snapshot as-of, not additive across dt.
scope_filter: product variation catalog snapshot; variation_removed='true'
aliases: removed_variation_count, removed variations, 已移除SKU, 已删除变体, 下架规格数

definition: Count of variation rows in the catalog snapshot enrolled in the Unity shipping program (is_unity = 'true'). Program-filtered catalog count; snapshot as-of, not additive across dt.
scope_filter: product variation catalog snapshot; is_unity='true'
aliases: unity_variation_count, Unity variations, Unity SKUs, Unity规格数, Unity变体数

definition: Count of distinct variation_id on commerce or merchant transaction line facts; a variation on many orders or lines is counted once. Not units sold and not product count.
scope_filter: commerce or merchant transaction line facts
aliases: variations ordered, sold SKUs, 成交SKU数, 下单变体数, 有成交规格数

definition: Count of distinct variation_id (SKU) with at least one refund line item in scope; a variation with many refund lines is counted once.
scope_filter: commerce transaction refund item facts
aliases: refunded_variations, refunded SKUs, 退款SKU数, 有退款变体数, 退款规格数

definition: Count of distinct variation_id among add-to-cart events; a variation added many times is counted once. Not ATC event count and not units added.
scope_filter: add-to-cart event detail
aliases: add_to_cart_variations, ATC variations, carted SKUs, 加购SKU数, 加购变体数, 加购规格数

definition: Count of distinct variation_id among order-tracking records; a variation with many tracking rows is counted once.
scope_filter: order tracking facts
aliases: distinct_variations, tracked variations, 有运单SKU数, 有物流变体数, 有物流规格数

definition: Count of distinct purchased variation_id that received at least one logged product-rating event. Null variation ids are ignored.
scope_filter: product rating event log
aliases: distinct_rated_variations, rated variations, 有评价SKU数, 有评分变体数, 被评价规格数

definition: Sum of merchant-user account total_skus (SKU/variation counters) as recorded on the current merchant_user dump. Account-grain snapshot sum — not additive over dump dates; not catalog row count and not count_distinct of variation_id.
scope_filter: merchant_user account snapshot; total_skus attribute
aliases: total_skus, merchant total SKUs, merchant SKU count, 商家SKU合计, 账号规格数

definition: Sum of Wish Cash (store credit) applied at commerce variation grain, excluding limited-time-deal lines. Buyer payment-instrument credit on the outlay side — not merchandise GMV, not discount_amount, and not external card GMV. Additive after proportional line allocation; multi-currency and not exchange-rate adjusted.
scope_filter: paid commerce variation lines; excl LTD; excl Wish Cash/BNPL special variations; excl pending/declined/exception; excl refunds before payment received; exclude is_testing
aliases: wish cash,wish cash excl ltd,store credit spent,Wish Cash applied,Wish Cash 抵扣,余额支付,wish cash amount

definition: Same variation-grain Wish Cash sum as sum_excl_ltd, with limited-time-deal lines kept. Broader unfiltered Wish Cash variant — not interchangeable with the house excl-LTD recipe.
scope_filter: paid commerce variation lines; incl LTD; excl Wish Cash/BNPL special variations; excl pending/declined/exception; excl refunds before payment received; exclude is_testing
aliases: wish cash with ltd,wish_cash_w_ltd,含LTD Wish Cash,含LTD余额支付

member_zh: 交易级 Wish Cash 抵扣
definition: Sum of the transaction-level amount paid with Wish Cash (wish_cash_paid / cash_applied). On line-grain sources the value is repeated on every line of the same transaction, so collapse to one row per transaction_id before summing. Not interchangeable with variation-allocated Wish Cash without that collapse.
scope_filter: commerce transaction facts; exclude is_testing
aliases: wish_cash_paid,cash applied,transaction wish cash,交易级Wish Cash,订单Wish Cash抵扣

definition: Count of feed-tile interaction detail rows with `action` = 'add_to_wishlist'. Tile grain: one logged wishlist-add of a multi-product feed counts once per product. Includes bot traffic. Event-row count — not a sum of daily wishlist counters, not remove-from-wishlist, and not distinct wishlist users.
scope_filter: feed-tile interaction detail; action=add_to_wishlist; includes bots
aliases: add to wishlist, wish button clicks, feed tile wishlist adds, 收藏事件数, 收藏次数, feed_tile_add_to_wishlist

definition: Count of feed-tile interaction detail rows with `action` = 'remove_from_wishlist'. Tile grain; includes bot traffic. Remove-side counterpart of the add event count — still an event-row count, not distinct users and not a sum of daily counters.
scope_filter: feed-tile interaction detail; action=remove_from_wishlist; includes bots
aliases: remove from wishlist, unwishlist, 取消收藏, 取消收藏事件数, feed_tile_remove_from_wishlist

definition: Sum of pre-aggregated wishlist action counters (wish-button clicks or same-day wishlist actions) at product-day or user-day grain. Additive across entities and days — five wishlist actions contribute five. Upstream bot/guest filters vary by source. Never average; not an event-row count and not distinct wishlist users.
scope_filter: product-day or user-day wishlist action counters (e.g. wishes, num_of_wishlists); upstream bot/guest filters vary by source
aliases: wishes, num_of_wishlists, wishlist actions sum, 收藏次数合计, 日收藏次数, wish button click sum
